title: Indkøbsansvarlig
description:
Er du den, der kan sikre, at de rette materialer kommer i hus, og har du mod på en rolle med indkøb og teamansvar som omdrejningspunkt?


Stillingen ved Evapco Europe byder på et bredt ansvar i en veletableret, international vækstvirksomhed, hvor du kan forme din rolle og gøre en forskel.

¤Ansvarsområder

Som supply chain team lead hos Evapco Europe bliver du en vigtig del af indkøbsafdelingen i Aabybro. Du får ansvar for operationelt indkøb, primært ordrebaseret, samt teamledelsen af en shippingmedarbejder/indkøber og to lagermedarbejdere. Strategisk indkøb fylder ca. 30 % i jobbet. Du vil opleve et bredt samarbejde med både salg, produktion, lager og leverandører, og derfor er evnen til at kommunikere bredt en vigtig succesfaktor i jobbet. Virksomheden har ved årsskiftet konverteret til Business Central fra Axapta.

¤Dine arbejdsopgaver:

• Dagligt ordrebaseret indkøb af og kontraktforhandlinger på materialer og råvarer, særligt rustfrit stål, kobber m.m.
• Forecasting
• Logistik og ordretransport
• Dialog og koordinering med leverandører i bl.a. Danmark, Italien og Kina
• Kvartalsvise budget- og prisindekseringsmøder med ledelsen
• Daglig teamledelse samt årlige løn- og medarbejdersamtaler

Du vil i jobbet referere til den europæiske indkøbsdirektør, der er lokaliseret i Italien, og du vil samarbejde med dine kolleger i Belgien og Italien. Der vil være ca. 20 årlige rejsedage, primært i forbindelse med leverandørbesøg.

¤Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du kommer med nogle års erfaring som indkøber, supply chain-ansvarlig eller lignende i en produktions- eller industrivirksomhed. Du trives med operationelt indkøb og synes, det vil være en spændende udfordring at motivere og lede et mindre team.
Som person ser vi gerne, at du er struktureret og selvstændig, og at du kan lide at skabe relationer til både dine leverandører og kolleger.
Koncernsproget er engelsk, så gode kundskaber i både skrift og tale er vigtigt.

¤Evapco tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med en flad struktur, hvor humøret er højt og samarbejdet godt blandt de 65 kolleger på tværs af afdelingerne. Udover dette vil du få løn efter kvalifikationer. Der vil være fokus på din trivsel og udvikling, og der er derfor mulighed for uddannelser og kurser.

Denne rekruttering håndteres af Randstad, og alle henvendelser bedes rettet hertil.

¤Om Evapco Europe A/S
Evapco Europe er specialiseret inden for produktion og udvikling af specialdesignede varmevekslere til en lang række brancher inden for bl.a. energi-, fødevare- og industrisektoren. Evapco Europe har fabrikker i Italien, Belgien og Danmark og er en del af en større global organisation med hovedsæde i Taneytown, Maryland, USA. Evapco Europe blev grundlagt i 1992 som Flex Coil, blev i 2009 opkøbt af amerikanske Evapco og består i dag af samlet 3.000 dygtige kolleger. Man har vækstet støt de senere år, og det forventes at fortsætte i de kommende år.

¤Om Randstad
Hos Randstad hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder med at udnytte deres fulde potentiale. Vi kombinerer viden med moderne teknologi for at skabe forandringer, der hjælper mennesker fremad. Vi kalder det Human Forward.
Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group, som er verdens største udbyder af HR-løsninger. Med over 4.700 kontorer fordelt på 39 lande formidler vi hver dag arbejde til mere end 650.000 mennesker verden over.
I Danmark er vi blandt de førende vikar- og rekrutteringsbureauer med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding. En position, vi har opnået, fordi vi som eksperter på arbejdsmarkedet formår at matche kvalificerede kandidater med de rette jobmuligheder.

Virksomheden er en mindre, seriøs og ambitiøs aktør med fokus på kvalitet, ordentlighed og langvarige kunderelationer. Der er styr på tingene – og samtidig plads til nye idéer og udvikling.

title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Århus
description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrik i Skejby. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Det er ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Med udgangspunkt fra vores fabrik i Skejby bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Plant Supervisor, Casper Sakskjær Nielsen, på telefon +45 2688 4995.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

title: Produktionsmedarbejder 5 dages nathold
description:
Der er brug for dig hos en af danmarks førende producenter af beton facade elementer beliggende i udkanten af aarhus!

Er du en natteravn som er klar på at indtræde i et spændende og travlt produktionsmiljø? Hertil vil du få stor frihed under ansvar og god oplæring.

Om stillingen
Opgaverne er mange på natholdet - men det primære ansvar er ift. afforming og fjernelse af forskalling, så der er klar til alle dem som møder ind på dagholdet. Med andre ord vil det sige rengøringsopgaver af mange forskellig slags.

Vi er på jagt efter den helt rette personlighed som kan indgå på det her specielle nathold - som gerne skulle have fysikken i orden og hænderne skruet ordentlig på. Ingen uddannelse eller erfaring nødvendig. Du vil blive ansat på et try n hire forløb med henblik på fastansættelse efter endt forløb. Efter 5 uger vil du indtræde i akkorden.

Dine opgaver
- Generel rengøring og klargøring af forme
- Afforming & fjernelse af forskalling
- Diverse produktionsopgaver

Vi forventer
- Du er mødestabil
- Du trives med fysisk arbejde
- Trives på et nathold

Vi tilbyder
- En yderst konkurrencedygtig lønpakke
- Job hos en virksomhed i stor vækst
- Akkord løn
- Stort fællesskab og god oplæring

Ansøg
Hvis du synes at ovenstående lyder spændende, ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV. Tryk på knappen 'ansøg nu' for at sende dit CV. Såfremt du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Asmus Dam på tlf. 4880 8201. Vi afholder løbende samtaler, og alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Om randstad
Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

title: Löneansvarig till Deichmanns huvudkontor i Köpenhamn
description:
Deichmann Sko söker en löneansvarig för de svenska lönerna till vårt huvudkontor i centrala Köpenhamn.

Om jobbet

Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för löneprocessen i Deichmann Sko Sverige? Som Löneansvarig ansvarar du självständigt för hela den svenska lönehanteringen och är företagets specialist inom svensk lön. Du säkerställer att våra medarbetare får rätt lön i rätt tid och är ett viktigt stöd för våra butikschefer och medarbetare i lönerelaterade frågor.

Tjänsten är placerad på Deichmanns nordiska huvudkontor i centrala Köpenhamn, som ansvarar för Deichmanns verksamhet i Danmark och Sverige. Du blir en del av vårt svenska HR-team bestående av en HR Manager och en HR-koordinator och arbetar i nära samarbete med HR kring personaladministration, kollektivavtal och löneprocesser. Samtidigt bidrar du aktivt till att utveckla och effektivisera våra arbetssätt och system.

Som ensam ansvarig för den svenska löneprocessen har du en nyckelroll i verksamheten och rapporterar till vår Finance, IT & Admin Director.

Så får du en bra start hos oss

För att ge dig en bra start i rollen erbjuder vi en överlämningsperiod på två månader. Under denna tid arbetar du tillsammans med vår nuvarande Löneansvarig och får en gedigen introduktion till våra system, rutiner och arbetssätt innan du tar över det fulla ansvaret för den svenska löneprocessen.

Eftersom vår nuvarande Löneansvarig går i pension den 30 april 2027 sker tillträde till tjänsten den 1 mars 2027.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Självständig månatlig lönekörning till för närvarande +250 medarbetare i våra 40 svenska butiker.
    Daglig kontroll, validering och korrigering av löne- och personaluppgifter i relevanta system.
    Dagligt samarbete med HR-avdelningen och support till butikschefer i löpande löneadministration.
    Avstämning, redovisning av skatt AGI, semester, pension, arbetsgivarintyg m.m.
    Kontroll av automatisk bokföring av lönjournaler och diverse löneavstämningar.
    Underhåll och utveckling av lönesystemet (SAP) i samarbete med vårt huvudkontor i Tyskland.
    Bevakning och implementering av lagändringar som påverkar löneområdet.
    Ad hoc uppgifter och optimering av processer i lönearbetet.

Dina kvalifikationer

    Relevant utbildning inom lön eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet för svenska löner, gärna inom detaljhandeln.
    Tidigare erfarenhet av att självständigt ansvara för hela löneprocessen och genomföra lönekörningar från A till Ö för större personalgrupper.
    Kunskap inom kollektivavtal, arbetsrätt och skatt.
    God systemvana och analytisk förmåga.
    Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och erfarenhet av att ta fram rapporter och analyser.
    Flytande kunskap i svenska, i tal och skrift.

Dina egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, flexibel och trygg i din yrkesroll. Du är en problemlösare som ser möjligheter framför begränsningar och arbetar noggrant med stor känsla för detaljer. Samtidigt har du lätt för att överblicka, strukturera och prioritera dina arbetsuppgifter, även under perioder med högt tempo och fasta deadlines.

Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för ditt eget arbetsområde, samtidigt som du är kommunikativ, samarbetsorienterad och uppskattar ett nära samarbete med kollegor inom HR. Du bidrar aktivt till ett gott samarbetsklimat och har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer.

Vi erbjuder

    Ett härligt samarbete med 35 trevliga och kompetenta danska och svenska kollegor på huvudkontoret.
    En arbetsplats i hjärtat av Köpenhamn, mitt emot centralstationen i trevliga och ljusa lokaler.
    Eget kontor tillsammans med HR, med goda möjligheter till både fokus och samarbete.
    Fast anställning.
    37 timmars arbetsvecka (heltid).
    Lön efter kvalifikationer.
    Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och inflytande på det egna arbetsområdet.
    Tjänstepension, personalmatsal, personalrabatter och personalförening.
    Möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån upp till 2 dagar i veckan.

Intresserad?

Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen och tycker att rollen låter intressant? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig. Skicka in din ansökan redan idag via länken nedan.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag om vi hittar rätt person. Tillsättning för tjänsten är den 1 mars 2027.

Har du övriga frågor gällande tjänsten så kontakta Finance, IT & Admin. Director Mikkel Linck på telefonnummer +45 33 34 38 22.

Vi tar endast emot elektroniska ansökningar via länk nedan.

DEICHMANN-koncernen är marknadsledande i Europa och grundades i Essen 1913 av Heinrich Deichmann. Det är idag en familjedriven verksamhet med tredje generationen vid rodret. Verksamheten har genom åren haft en kontinuerlig tillväxt och är nu representerad i 30 länder med mer än 4.000 butiker över hela världen.

Deichmann är en modern verksamhet som med visionen ”Verksamheten ska tjäna människan” lägger stor vikt vid medarbetarnas trivsel, fokus på bra arbetsvillkor för såväl våra medarbetare som samarbetspartners, och inte minst på att ge kunderna trendiga kvalitetsskor till bra priser. Detta uppnås genom direkta globala inköp, teamwork och en människoorienterad verksamhetskultur.

Sedan 2003 är Deichmann Sko representerat i Danmark och sedan 2007 även i Sverige. Deichmann Sko fortsätter att expandera i Sverige och Danmark de närmaste åren. Vi kan erbjuda dig ett spännande jobb där du har möjlighet att utvecklas både professionellt och personligen. Läs gärna mer om oss på deichmann.com.

title: Allmänmedicin läkare till Danmark - Vi skräddarsyr ditt nästa äventyr!
description:
Går du i tankarna på att arbeta i Danmark, antingen nu eller i framtiden? Vi söker kontinuerligt duktiga specialister i allmänmedicin för kommande och långsiktiga uppdrag över hela Danmark.

Vi vet att livet består av mer än bara jobb. Därför utgår vi alltid från dina personliga önskemål. Om du har familj, vill bo på en specifik ort eller har specifika önskemål kring ditt schema, så anpassar vi vårt sökande efter dig, inte efter en fast låst list

Vill du arbeta i ett hälso- och sjukvårdssystem som värnar om din arbetsmiljö? Här får du chansen till ett meningsfullt arbete med stor flexibilitet, rimliga patientflöden och ett starkt team av sjuksköterskor runt dig. Du kommer att få mer stöd från övrig vårdpersonal och hanterar mindre administration. Det gör att du äntligen kan fokusera på det medicinska!

Vi erbjuder ett års visstidsanställning, men ser gärna att det leder till en tillsvidareanställning.

Arbetstider och balans i livet:

Arbetet är som utgångspunkt heltid, måndag till fredag kl. 08–16, men det finns möjlighet att arbeta på minst 75 % tjänstgöringsgrad. Du arbetar alltså vardagar 08–16, med betald lunch och helt utan jour, övertid eller helgarbete. Du får en mer förutsägbar arbetsdag och betydligt bättre möjligheter att planera livet utanför arbetet.

Ekonomi och förmåner:

Som svensk specialistläkare kan du, om du uppfyller kraven, omfattas av den danska expertskatten med en fast skattesats på 32,8 %. Det innebär mer pengar kvar i plånboken och större frihet på fritiden.

Vi löser det praktiska åt dig:

Att flytta till ett annat land ska inte behöva vara krångligt. Du behöver inte börja om, du tar med dig din erfarenhet och kompetens, så hjälper vi dig genom hela processen:

    Auktorisation & myndigheter: Vi hjälper dig med det administrativa inför din start i Danmark.
    Möblerat boende: Vi ordnar boende inför din ankomst och presenterar alternativ som passar din placering.
    Språk & introduktion: Du får en intensiv språkutbildning på ca 20 timmar med erfarna språklärare samt en introduktionsvecka där du kommer in i arbetssättet, systemen och den danska vården.
    Personligt stöd: Du har en personlig kontakt genom hela processen, från första samtalet tills du är etablerad.

Din erfarenhet:

    Legitimerad läkare
    Specialist i allmänmedicin
    Kunna prata och skriva på flytande svenska
    Meriterande att kunna förstå och prata danska

Låter det intressant för dig? Ansök genom att skicka ditt CV till mig Felix på felix.hellstrom@vbsverige.se eller göra en intresseanmälan på vår hemsida (https://vbsverige.se/lakare-i-danmark/).

Vi ser fram emot att starta en dialog med dig!

OM OSS

Vårdbemanning Sverige startade sin verksamhet 2014 och är idag ett av Sveriges största bemanningsföretag inom hälso- och sjukvård. Sedan 2019 har vi utsetts till ett av landets Gasellföretag av Dagens Industri, och utmärker oss som ett av landets snabbast växande företag. Vi erbjuder bemannings- och rekryteringslösningar till Sveriges regioner, privata vårdgivare och kommuner.

Så fungerar det

Det första steget till att arbeta via oss i Danmark är att vi startar en profil på dig i vårt verksamhetssystem. Vi börjar processen med ett initialt telefonsamtal där vi får veta mer om dig, din bakgrund och dina erfarenheter, samtidigt som du får svar på alla dina frågor om oss och om hur allt fungerar. För att kunna starta din profil och gå vidare behöver vi också få in ett antal handlingar från dig, såsom ditt CV och dina referenser.

Under våra samtal går vi även igenom vilket/vilka ställen du vill eller kan tänka dig jobba på, vilket geografiskt område som passar dig bäst samt ramarna för lönepaketen. När vi har hittat rätt matchning och samlat in alla uppgifter, sammanställer vi detta till en presentation för Nordic Medicare.

När presentationen är klar lämnar vi över till Nordic Medicare som då tar vid för den fortsatta processen. De kommer att hålla en uppföljande intervju med dig och sköta den konkreta dialogen kring själva anställningen. Det är också direkt med Nordic Medicare som du går igenom alla slutgiltiga arbetsrättsliga villkor, avtalsspecifika bestämmelser, juridik och eventuella frågor kring forskarskatteordningen. På så sätt får du en samlad, trygg och tydlig dialog om alla kontraktets detaljer direkt med din kommande arbetsgivare.

När du är ute och arbetar har du kontinuerlig dialog med din närmsta kontaktperson hos oss, som vägleder och stöttar dig genom uppdraget från början till slut. Vi sätter stort värde på att vara tillgänglig för dig. Du kan alltid nå oss på telefon eller mejl när du behöver.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance - Functional Solution Architect
description:

Seeking a candidate with 5+ years of Dynamics 365 Finance experience with a strong finance background. While various profiles may apply, we highly value a strong person-organization fit. Our ideal candidate possesses the following attributes and qualifications:

We can't wait to hear from you!

Our global reach spans from Greenland to Australia, as we partner with leading travel agencies, airlines, and leisure-focused businesses to craft tailor-made solutions. Join us in reshaping the travel industry landscape, where responsiveness and innovation are our guiding stars.

Diversity and Inclusion

At our company, Diversity and Inclusion are core values. We welcome applicants of all genders, striving for a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Join us in building an inclusive future where diversity is celebrated as a strength

title: Specialiseret butiksmedarbejder/knivspecialist. Specialist retail assistent - Japanese as working language
description:
Arbejdssted: København Location: Copenhagen

Arbejdstid: Fuldtid 37 timer om ugen. Working hours. Full-time, 37 hours per week.

Ansættelsesform: Fastansættelse Employment: Permanent position.

Om stillingen:

Vi søger en engageret medarbejder til vores specialiserede butik med fokus på japanske kvalitetsknive og japansk knivhåndværk.

Stillingen er en kombination af salg og kundeservice, arbejde med slibning af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen kombinerer salg og kundeservice med praktisk arbejde, slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

En væsentlig del af stillingen indebærer direkte kommunikation med japanske producenter og leverandører. Derfor er gode japanske sprogkundskaber en nødvendighed kompetence i stillingen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

Salg og rådgivning af kunder om japanske kvalitetsknive og tilbehør.

Kundeservice og vejledning om valg, brug og vedligeholdelse af knive.

Slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive, samt indgravering i hånden.

Modtagelse, kontrol og håndtering af varer.

Vare- og lagerstyring.

Kommunikation med japanske leverandører og producenter,

Håndtering af profuktinformation, ordrer, specifikationer og leverancer.

Oversættelse og videreformidling af information mellem virksomheden og japanske leverandører.

Bidrage til den daglige drift og præsentation af butikken.

Vi forventer, at du:

Taler og skriver japansk på højt niveau.

Kan kommunikere proffesionelt med vores japanske leverandører både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Har interesse for japanske knive, håndværk og kvalitet.

Har gode kundeservice- og salgsevner.

Er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst.

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

Har interesse for eller erfaring med knivslibning.

Behersker engelsk, så du kan kommunikere med kolleger og kunder.

Erfaring med knivslibning, salg eller arbejde med japanske knive er en fordel. Erfaring med håndgravering er ligeledes en fordel. Oplæring i virksomhedens produkter og arbejdsmetoder vil blive givet efter behov.

Japansk er et nødvendigt arbejdssprog, da medarbejderne vil have løbende kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører, vedrørende blandt andet produktinformation, bestillinger, specifikationer og leverancer.

Vi tilbyder:

Fast ansættelse på 37 timer om ugen.

En alsidig stilling i en specialiseret butik.

Arbejde med japanske kvalitetsprodukter og knivhåndværk.

Direkte kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører.

Oplæring i produkter, knivtyper og slibeteknikker.

Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og god kundeservice.

Løn: Efter aftale.

Ansøgning:

Send CV og ansøgning til tess@foodgear.dk.

Fortæl gerne om din baggrund og erfaring med japansk håndværk, samt dine sprogkundskaber.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and service-minded employee to join our specialized shop, focusing on high quality Japanese knives and Japanese knife craftmanship.

The position combines sales and customer service with practical work, involving knife sharpening and maintenance, as well as ongoing communication with our Japanese suppliers and business partners.

A significant part of the postion involves direct communication with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers. Therefore, a high level of Japanese language proficiency is an essential requirement for the position.

Providing customer service andguidance on the selection, use and maintenance of knives.

Knife sharpening, maintenance and hand engraving.

Receiving, checking and handling goods.

A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

A varied position in a specialised retail shop.

The opportunity to work with high-quality Japanese products and traditional knife craftmanship.

Direct contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers.

Training in products, knife types and sharpening techniques.

A working environment focused on quality, expertise and excellent customer service.

How to apply: Please send an email with your CV and application to tess@foodgear.dk

Please include information about your experience with Japanese products, knives, sales, customer service as well as your Japanese and English skills.

title: PhD Stipend in Digital Twin Modelling and Multi-Timescale Optimization of Electrolysis Systems
description:
Help to build the digital backbone of tomorrow's Power-to-X plants. This 3-year PhD position offers a unique opportunity to build a research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems. You will drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies, integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand, to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolysers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University, and research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
You will develop and validate digital-twin and optimization methods for electrolysis systems, working both independently and collaboratively with the group and with academic and industrial partners. In particular, you will:

  • Develop and validate physics-based, data-driven, or hybrid digital twins of Electrolysis systems, capturing their electrochemical, thermal, flow, and system-level behaviour for system monitoring, state estimation, and performance prediction.
  • Build computationally efficient models suitable for monitoring, performance prediction, optimization, and control, and evaluate their accuracy, robustness, computational efficiency, and practical applicability. They could also be implemented in real-time systems.
  • Investigate interactions across operational timescales (Multi-timescale optimization) — from short-term power, thermal, and flow management to longer-term production scheduling and energy-system operation — connecting fast system dynamics with slower operational decisions.
  • Develop optimization strategies to improve Electrolyzer performance, efficiency, flexibility, and economic operation under variable electricity supply and renewable-energy integration.
  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project activities.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies 
We expect you to have:

  • A relevant master's degree in energy engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, control engineering, or a related discipline.
  • A strong foundation in at least one of: electrochemical or energy-system modelling, dynamic modelling and control, mathematical optimization, or data-driven modelling.
  • Experience with numerical modelling, simulation, optimization, control, or engineering-data analysis.
  • Good programming skills in Python, MATLAB/Simulink, or a comparable scientific computing environment.
  • A fundamental understanding of energy-conversion systems, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, heat and mass transfer, electrochemistry, or control engineering.
  • The ability to conduct independent, systematic, and scientifically rigorous research while working effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with some of the areas of electrolyzer technologies, digital twins, model order reduction, system identification, power electronics, model predictive control, multi-objective optimization, machine learning, renewable-energy integration, experimental testing, or hardware-in-the-loop implementation would be an advantage. You are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are
The PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • A project description (3–5 pages) outlining your initial thoughts and ideas on the project applied for, including a brief state-of-the-art with a short list of references, a time schedule, and how you intend to address the project objectives.
  • Publications, if applicable.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Postdoc Position in System Optimization Using Digital Twin for Power-to-X processes
description:
Take the next step in your research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale system optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems with special focus on the electrical engineering parts. This position offers a unique opportunity to drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies—integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power electronic conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand—to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolyzers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University — research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
This two-year postdoctoral project focuses on the system-level integration and optimization of electrolyzer digital twins within CAPeX — considering how component-level electrolyzer models and digital twins can be incorporated into broader Power-to-X systems involving renewable generation, power conversion, power system integration, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand. In particular, you will:

  • Develop an integrated, system-level digital-twin framework connecting electrolyzer models with relevant Power-to-X components and energy-systema.
  • Develop system-level optimization and energy-management methods for coordinating electrolyzers with renewable generation, power conversion, storage, downstream processes, and hydrogen demand.
  • Apply and evaluate these methods under technical constraints and varying renewable generation, electricity prices, and hydrogen demand, considering system efficiency, flexibility, production, and operating costs.
  • Validate and benchmark the developed framework using project data, high-fidelity simulations including hardware in the loop, and relevant industrial case studies, assessing its robustness and computational performance.
  • Collaborate with researchers and industrial partners, contribute to the coordination and supervision of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies
We expect you to have:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in energy-system modelling, mathematical optimization, control, digital twins, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and numerical modelling skills using Python, MATLAB/Simulink, Julia, hardware in the loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as multi-objective optimization, model predictive control, mixed-integer optimization, stochastic optimization, energy management, or production scheduling.
  • Good knowledge of integrated energy systems; experience with electrolyzers, hydrogen technologies, renewable-energy integration, storage, or Power-to-X systems would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be a specialist in every electrolyzer technology or optimization method. Strong system-level modelling and optimization competence, together with the ability to work across component and system boundaries, is particularly important.

Who we are
The position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg. Read more at www.energy.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions?
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us.

For professional questions, please contact Frede Blaabjerg, Professor, fbl@energy.aau.dk, +45 2129 2454.

Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Kontorleder søges
description:
OFFICE MANAGER WANTED FOR OUR OFFICE IN ØSTERBRO

Are you service-minded, organised, and the kind of person who keeps the office running smoothly – even when things get busy?

We are looking for a dedicated Office Manager for a permanent position at our office in Østerbro, Copenhagen.

As our Office Manager, you will be a central part of our day-to-day operations and play an important role in ensuring that the office runs professionally and efficiently.

We operate a staffing agency where the pace can be fast. Phones are ringing, candidates are coming and going, and there are always people, appointments, and tasks that need to be coordinated.

That is why we are looking for someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys working with people, and appreciates a varied working day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be responsible for the day-to-day running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Daily office administration and coordination
• Welcoming candidates, temporary workers, clients, and other visitors
• Answering phone calls and emails
• Managing calendars and coordinating meetings and interviews
• Preparing meeting rooms and office facilities
• Ordering office supplies, refreshments, and other necessities
• Handling post, parcels, and deliveries
• Liaising with suppliers and business partners
• Providing practical support with the onboarding of new employees and temporary workers
• Updating and maintaining administrative information and documents
• Planning internal events and social activities
• Handling administrative and practical ad hoc tasks

You will also be an important source of support for our consultants and management team, helping to create structure and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

WHO ARE YOU?

Above all, we are looking for someone who takes ownership of the office and wants to make a positive difference in the workplace.

You notice what needs to be done, take initiative, and make sure tasks are followed through from start to finish.

We imagine that you:

• Are organised and have a strong sense of overview
• Are outgoing, positive, and service-minded
• Take responsibility and are comfortable working independently
• Enjoy working with people and communicate professionally
• Are able to manage several tasks at the same time
• Thrive in an environment where the day does not always go according to plan
• Have good IT skills
• Communicate confidently in Danish and preferably also in English
• Contribute positively to the atmosphere and sense of community in the office

Previous experience as an Office Manager, receptionist, administrative coordinator, PA, or office assistant is an advantage. However, your personality, way of working, and willingness to take responsibility are just as important to us.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

You will have a permanent base at our office in Østerbro and become an important part of our internal team.

At the same time, we believe in flexibility and freedom with responsibility. Depending on your tasks and by prior agreement, there will therefore be an opportunity to work from home a few days per week. Tasks that require your physical presence will, of course, be carried out from our office in Østerbro.

With us, you can expect a working day filled with people, responsibility, and plenty of variety. There is a short path from idea to action, and you will have the opportunity to shape both your role and the way we run our office.

We offer:

• A permanent position based at our office in Østerbro
• The opportunity to work from home a few days per week
• Flexibility and freedom with responsibility
• A central role with responsibility and influence
• A varied working day
• Close collaboration with both colleagues and management
• An informal, fast-paced working environment
• Opportunities for professional and personal development

Location: Østerbro, Copenhagen / opportunity to work from home
Position: Full-time
Start date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Salary: Based on qualifications

COULD YOU BE THE PERSON WHO KEEPS OUR OFFICE RUNNING SMOOTHLY?

Send your CV and a short application to info@manora.dk.

Please tell us a little about yourself and why you could see yourself becoming part of our team.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Postdoctoral Position in Animal Welfare Risks of Feeding Red Seaweed to Dairy Cows
description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a full-time postdoctoral position. The two-year position is available from 1 February 2027, or soon thereafter. The position will be in the research unit Behaviour, stress and welfare (BSW).

Dairy cattle contribute substantially to agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, primarily through enteric methane production, making the identification of effective nutritional mitigation strategies an important area of research. While the feed additive Bovaer has received considerable attention for its methane-reducing effects, concerns regarding animal health and welfare have led to increasing interest in alternative solutions, including seaweed-based feed additives. The seaweed Asparagopsis spp. has shown significant methane-mitigating potential; however, its use has also raised animal welfare concerns. Consequently, there is a need to evaluate the animal welfare effects of seaweed-based feed additives.

Research tasks
  • Evaluating the effects of seaweed-based feed additives on the behaviour and welfare of dairy cattle.
  • Investigating behavioural indicators of discomfort and pain associated with feed management.
  • Validating welfare assessment measures through experimental approaches, including pharmacological interventions.
  • Contributing to scientific publications and dissemination of research results.
  • Participating in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contributing to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.


Qualifications
We are seeking a candidate who has:
  • A PhD degree or equivalent in biology, animal science, veterinary science, or a related field, and research experience in animal behaviour and welfare.
  • A strong interest in strategies aimed at reducing the climate impact of dairy production through feeding management.
  • At least a basic understanding of feeding management.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate scientific research results effectively.
  • The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, a commitment to learning Danish, including reading, writing, and speaking, is expected during the employment period.


Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Margit Bak Jensen, phone: +4522365482, email: margitbak.jensen@anivet.au.dk

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.


The candidate will have the opportunity to be trained and gain experience in:
  • Teaching and supervision of students at the BSc and MSc level through active involvement in teaching in animal science and in the veterinary science programme.
  • Research-based consultancy to authorities, where it is relevant.


Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg,
Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.



Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.



Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
Want to work with sustainability and software? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you.

We are looking for a software developer to join us to develop and maintain our digital platforms as we scale.

We do drone-based emissions monitoring across oil & gas, maritime, waste management, and other industries. By helping operators safely identify methane leaks and quantify emissions, we're proud to be supporting industry efforts to improve environmental performance while enhancing operational efficiency and asset integrity. We measure greenhouse gas emissions data from various sources and combining them with atmospheric data. Based on scientific methods we then quantify emissions and visualize the data to provide emissions intelligence to operations enabling actions on emissions.

We have a strong focus on R&D, and we are exploring new cutting-edge technologies and ideas to innovate what we can do within emissions monitoring.

The job

You will be part of a small, talented tech developer team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our digital platforms, which are the core of the products we deliver to customers.

As a Software Developer your responsibilities will include:

  • Co-development of our main applications Microsoft Azure, Blazor Server Application (C#)

  • Co-development of our calculation engine, Microsoft Azure Function (Python)

  • Develop new, more appealing user experiences aimed at different user groups to view products and services.

  • Maintain databases, application services and reporting landscape specific to the European maritime emission monitoring set-up.

  • Improve analysis tools and the user experience for the customers, the drone pilot and the internal project manager in collaboration with the project manager running the campaigns.

About you

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

  • A bachelor's degree or master’s degree in engineering, data science, software design, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar

  • Experience with code development in C# and Python and preferable Rust

  • Experience with database design (SQL)

  • Familiar with software development processes in Azure DevOps

  • Experience with development of user interfaces and UX design is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Fluent in English. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Genuine interest in technology and IT infrastructure

  • Structured and focused on delivering quality work and being a good team player.

 

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact on cutting industrial emissions

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance

  • Software ownership early on, with senior developers to learn from

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early

  • A supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning

  • Job location is just north of Copenhagen in Virum, Denmark.

Application and information

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we will be evaluating applications on an ongoing basis. Application deadline is 18 October 2026. Expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Please send your application, including your motivation and what a competence you bring, together with your CV to jobs@explicit.dk. Write “Software developer” in the subject field.

If you have any questions about the job, you are welcome to contact Rasmus Ebdrup, Chief Digital Officer at reb@explicit.dk

___________________________________________________________________________________

About Explicit

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish green tech company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industries. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology.

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. Read more about what we do at explicit.dk

title: Pædagogisk assistent til vuggestue
description:
Børnehytten søger en dedikeret pædagogisk assistent til vores vuggestue.

Hvem er vi: 

Vi er en privat integreret daginstitution beliggende i hjertet af Kettinge. Vi er normeret til 12 vuggestuebørn og 29 børnehavebørn. Vi har tæt samarbejde med forældrebestyrelse og det lokale forenings- og forretningsliv.

Huset rummer nærhed, omsorg og sammenhold for børnene såvel som for kollegaerne. Vi har fokus på trivsel og tryghed og vægter derfor bl.a. forældrekontakten højt. Vi er gode til at arbejde sammen og spille hinanden gode i hverdagen. Grundet husets størrelse er der en naturlig god relation til børnene på tværs af stuerne og vi kan hurtigt træde til på alle stuer, hvis behovet opstår. 

Børnehytten støder op til en tidligere grusgrav, der nu fungerer som rekreativt område med bålhytte, naturlegeplads, kunstige søer med fisk og mange andre muligheder for udfoldelser med børnene. Derudover har vi vores egen legeplads der er opdelt i vuggestue og børnehave, hvor vi prioriterer at børnene kommer ud hver dag. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du nyder at være en del af udelivet uanset vind og vejr, da vores børn også elsker at hoppe i vandpytter, kigge på biller og finde regnorme.

I vuggestuen er værdien af tid central for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Tid til nærvær, tid til fordybelse og tid til at skabe små betydningsfulde øjeblikke der danner fundamentet for børnenes læring, udvikling, trivsel og dannelse. Vi har fokus på at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer, hvor alle børn – uanset behov og forudsætning -har mulighed for at deltage i meningsfulde fællesskaber.

Vi forventer af dig:

Du er uddannet pædagogisk assistent og gerne med erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Du er empatisk, omsorgsfuld og vægter arbejdet med relationer højt. Du er nysgerrig og legende i din tilgang til børnene og vægter tid, tillid og tryghed højt hos både store og små.

Du skal have en naturlig interesse og nysgerrighed på sproglig udvikling og brugen af det i hverdagen.

Du kan i samarbejde med dine kollegaer på stuen, planlægge aktiviteter og evaluere disse med udgangspunkt i den nye styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Du kan samarbejde med din kollegaer, om at vurdere børnenes trivsel og udvikling og ved behov iværksætte konkrete tiltag. Du skal kunne se det enkelte barn og bidrage til at udarbejde handleplaner, indstillinger, koordinere tværfagligt samarbejde med mere.

 

Om stillingen:

Vi tilbyder en ansættelse hurtigst mulig eller fra 1/11-26 i en 32 timers stilling efter gld. overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23/9-26 Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 40.

Send din ansøgning og CV til leder@boernehytten.dk

 

Kontakt gerne leder: Tinni eller souschef Stine - 53841514 - Man-Fredag kl. 9-15, for mere information.

title: Project Coordinator in Product and Supply
description:
Project Coordinator – Product & Supply

Do you enjoy creating structure, improving processes, and coordinating projects across different teams? Are you highly organized, analytical, and motivated by making operations run more efficiently? Then you might be our new Project Coordinator.

As Project Coordinator, you will play a key role in driving smaller projects and continuous process improvements within our Product & Supply organization. You will work closely with stakeholders across different departments to map, optimize, and maintain operational processes while ensuring consistency and efficiency throughout the supply chain.

Your responsibilities

As our new Project Coordinator, you will:

  • Lead and coordinate smaller internal projects within the Product & Supply organization

  • Drive updates and continuous improvements to operational processes and procedures

  • Map, document, and analyze current supply chain processes

  • Develop, align, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across departments

  • Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvement initiatives

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather input and ensure alignment

  • Support timely execution of both operational tasks and longer-term initiatives

  • Facilitate recurring process reviews and operational performance updates
