title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
description:
About the position

Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities
  • Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
  • Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
  • Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
  • Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
  • Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
  • Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
  • Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
  • Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
  • Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance
  • Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
  • Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
  • Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background
  • You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar. Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
  • You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
  • Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
  • You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
  • You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
  • You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
  • You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.

Personal qualities
  • You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
  • You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
  • You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
  • You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
  • You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.

We offer
  • A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
  • A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
  • The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
  • Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
  • An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
  • Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.


Practical information

Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.
Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
Employment: Permanent position.

Application
Please send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

title: Lille selvejende institution søger pædagog
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde et sted, hvor du ikke bare er medarbejder, men en vigtig del af huset?

Så kom til Børnehuset Bellis.

Vi er et lille, hyggeligt og selvejende børnehus i København NV med en grøn legeplads, masser af god stemning og en hverdag, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling og stor mulighed for indflydelse. Her kender vi hinanden, ledelsen er tæt på, og der er plads til, at du kan være dig selv og til, at dine idéer kan blive til virkelighed.

Vi søger en pædagog på 37 timer om ugen til et barselsvikariat med mulighed for fastansættelse. Stillingen ønskes besat 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter. Vi søger også en fast pædagog fra 1. november 2026.

Et lille hus med store muligheder
Som selvejende institution har vi stor mulighed for selv at forme vores hverdag, pædagogik og traditioner. Vi har en aktiv forældrebestyrelse, som har reel indflydelse på børnehusets udvikling.

Det betyder blandt andet:
  • Kort vej fra idé til beslutning.
  • Stor medindflydelse på institutionens hverdag og udvikling.
  • Tæt samarbejde mellem medarbejdere, ledelse og bestyrelse.
  • Sundhedsforsikring til alle ansatte.
  • Større indflydelse på ferieplanlægningen.
  • Mulighed for at præge pædagogikken og skabe nye idéer.
  • En tæt og nærværende ledelse.

Hvem er vi?
Børnehuset Bellis er et hyggeligt hus med en dejlig grøn legeplads. Vi ligger tæt på skolehaverne, gode legepladser og grønne områder, som vi ofte bruger i hverdagen.

Vi har én vuggestuegruppe og to børnehavegrupper, normeret til 52 børn og fordi vi er et lille hus, kender børn og voksne hinanden på tværs.

Vi er optagede af at følge børnenes spor, skabe tryghed og gode rammer for leg, læring, udvikling og dannelse. Vi lægger vægt på en hverdag præget af nærvær, humor, omsorg og et stærkt kollegaskab.

Du skal søge hos os, hvis du:
  • Får energi af at arbejde med en mangfoldig børnegruppe.
  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at nytænke og udvikle.
  • Gerne vil arbejde i en selvejende institution med ledelsen tæt på.
  • Har lyst til at være en del af et engageret arbejdsfællesskab med fokus på børnenes trivsel, udvikling og dannelse.
  • Er god til struktur og organisering.
  • Værdsætter et godt og tæt forældresamarbejde.
  • Kan udarbejde handleplaner og omsætte dem til praksis.
  • Er mødestabil og tager ansvar for fællesskabet.

Måske har du flere års erfaring og masser af idéer med i bagagen. Måske er du nyuddannet og kommer med friske øjne, gåpåmod og lyst til at prøve dig selv af.

Begge dele er vi interesserede i.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du har lyst til at være en aktiv del af et lille hus, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab.

Kom gerne på besøg
Du er meget velkommen til at ringe og aftale et besøg – også inden du sender din ansøgning. Vi vil gerne møde dig og vise dig, hvem vi er.

Kontakt leder, Marlene på tlf. 5210 2120.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance - Functional Solution Architect
description:
Are you a Functional Solution Architect with a passion for providing top-notch service to customers, focusing on quality when implementing D365 solutions?

Join our team at TravelOperations and help us design and implement cutting-edge solutions that meet our clients' complex business needs.

Responsibilities

As a Functional Solution Architect at TravelOperations, you will play a key role in influencing and overseeing large-scale international implementation projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and implement enterprise-level solutions, ensuring they align with business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define functional requirements and develop architecture roadmaps.

  • Lead the integration of multiple systems to create seamless business processes.

  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with industry standards.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentor team members in best practices and emerging technologies.

  • Execute workshops, including in-depth analysis sessions, in collaboration with a team of Business Consultants to refine and validate solution designs.

  • Collaborate with skilled Developers to ensure the solution design is thoroughly tested and meets the technical and functional requirements.

  • Engage in General Architect work, such as exploring emerging technologies, conducting Proof of Concepts, and participating in Product Advisory Board activities with partners like Microsoft or industry-specific leaders such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.

  • Offer internal guidance and support to colleagues, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in architectural best practices.

  • Maintaining daily ownership of customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor in implementing scalable and secure solutions.

Desired Skills & Requirements

Seeking a candidate with 5+ years of Dynamics 365 Finance experience with a strong finance background. While various profiles may apply, we highly value a strong person-organization fit. Our ideal candidate possesses the following attributes and qualifications:

  • Extensive experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and proficiency in finance.

  • Proven experience as a Functional Solution Architect or in a similar role.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methodologies.

  • Proficiency in system integration, data migration, and cloud technologies.

  • Excellent communication skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality solutions within tight deadlines and the capability to lead functional areas within projects.

  • Certification in MB-310 / MB-700.

  • Dynamic, proactive, and possesses a comprehensive solution overview.

  • Exceptional consulting and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

title: Rengøringsplanlægger med stærke data- og analysekompetencer til Rigshospitalets Rengøringsafdeling
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre datadrevet planlægning i en af Danmarks største og mest komplekse rengøringsorganisationer?

Rengøringsafdelingen på Rigshospitalet søger en engageret og analytisk stærk rengøringsplanlægger til en tidsbegrænset stilling frem til 31. december 2027.

Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at kvalitetssikre og udvikle afdelingens planlægningsgrundlag gennem anvendelse af Data Know How (DKH). Dine analyser og planlægningsopgaver skal understøtte vigtige strategiske beslutninger om bemanding, økonomi og arbejdsmetoder i afdelingen.

Om stillingen

Som rengøringsplanlægger bliver du en vigtig del af afdelingens udviklingsarbejde. Du skal opbygge og vedligeholde rengøringsplaner og, i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger, sikre valide data som bidrag til et solidt beslutningsgrundlag for ledelsen.

Du skal være opmærksom på at oprydning af eksisterende planer og i DKH, kan forekomme.

Stillingen har særlig betydning i forbindelse med:

  • Planlægning og prissætning af rengøringsopgaver
  • Sammenholde instruktioner med tider i DKH
  • Understøttelse af afdelingens økonomiske prioriteringer
  • Implementering og anvendelse af CSL
  • Medvirke til at CSL og DKH bygger på samme logikker
  • Udvikling af arbejdsplaner og normeringer i forbindelse med ændringer i hospitalets fysiske rammer og byggeprojekter, sammen med ledere og medarbejdere
Du refererer til Souschef Anette Melkjorsen og arbejder tæt sammen med afdelingens ledere og administrative medarbejdere på begge matrikler (Østerbro og Glostrup), og du vil primært have base på Østerbro.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Vedligeholde, analysere og kvalitetssikre data i DKH
  • Udarbejde og optimere rengøringsplaner og normeringer
  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem datagrundlag, normering og drift
  • Udarbejde analyser, rapporter og beslutningsoplæg til ledelsen
  • Bidrage til implementering af nye planlægningsværktøjer og arbejdsgange
  • Sparre med ledergruppen omkring opgaveplanlægning, normering og data fra DKH
  • Medvirke til udviklingsprojekter og organisationsforandringer
  • Oplære og vejlede ledere og medarbejdere i anvendelsen af planlægningsværktøjer
Vi søger dig, som

  • Har indgående kendskab til Data Know How (DKH)
  • Har erfaring med planlægning og ressourceoptimering
  • Har stærke analytiske kompetencer og arbejder datadrevet
  • Er fortrolig med Excel
  • Kan omsætte komplekse data til praktiske løsninger
  • Arbejder struktureret og har fokus på kvalitet og detaljer
  • Trives i samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper og kulturer
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Har forståelse for økonomi, budgetter og normering
Erfaring fra rengøringsområdet, hospitalsdrift eller anden større serviceorganisation vil være en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central funktion i en afdeling med stor betydning for hospitalets drift og patientsikkerhed
  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af fremtidens rengøringsplanlægning
  • Tæt samarbejde med meget engagerede ledere og kolleger
  • Alsidige arbejdsopgaver med stor selvstændighed
  • En arbejdsplads præget af faglighed, udvikling og samarbejde
Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt, med ansættelse snarest og tidsbegrænset frem til 31. december 2027. Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst og aftaler i Region Hovedstaden.

title: Le Metier - Sous Chef to work in our new French Brasserie
description:
Le Metier is looking for a Sous Chef to work in our new French Brasserie

About the position

Le Metier is looking for a Sous Chef to join us and help take the next step in the development of our kitchen.

Le Metier is an independent restaurant located on Christianshavn, Copenhagen, built around the philosophy: good food, genuine hospitality, strong personalities and a restaurant that feel alive.

Le Métier is a new French restaurant on Strandgade 98 in Christianshavn, created by the people behind Lalala, Ma Cuisine and La Propina. The restaurant draws inspiration from the best classic French brasseries and restaurants and celebrates craftsmanship, technique, good ingredients and personal service. The expected opening is October/November 2026.

We are now looking for an ambitious Sous Chef who can work across both restaurants and become an important part of the next stage of our development.

The role

This position is about more than cooking good food. We are looking for someone who wants to help us build a stronger, more structured and more consistent kitchen while protecting the personality and energy of the restaurant.

Working closely with our head chef and management team, you will help us develop the way our kitchens operate every day.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining a consistently high standard of food and execution.

• Supporting and leading the kitchen teams during service.

• Making sure recipes, preparation and plating are clear and consistent.

• Improving mise en place, organisation and communication.

• Maintaining high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and kitchen maintenance.

• Supporting ordering, stock management and food-cost awareness.

• Training and developing younger members of the kitchen team.

• Helping create systems that make the kitchens more efficient and less dependent on individual people.

• Contributing ideas and feedback to the development of our menus.

• Creating a kitchen culture based on professionalism, respect, responsibility and pride in the craft.

Who we are looking for

• Has solid professional kitchen experience, ideally with experience in French and/or Mediterranean cuisine.

• Has strong technical foundations and genuinely cares about cooking.

• Understands that consistency is as important as creativity.

• Is organised and comfortable working with systems, recipes, prep lists and checklists.

• Can lead by example rather than simply giving instructions.

• Enjoys teaching and developing others.

• Takes responsibility for the kitchen, even when nobody is watching.

• Understands food cost, ordering, waste and the operational side of running a restaurant.

• Cares about cleanliness and organisation as much as what leaves the pass.

• Can remain calm, structured and positive during busy services.

• Wants to contribute ideas and challenge the way we currently work when something can be improved.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone with ambition and personality. We don’t want to create a kitchen without soul. We want a professional kitchen with strong systems behind it, giving talented people the freedom to focus on hospitality, creativity and great food.

What we offer

You will join a restaurant that are currently evolving and help professionalizing our operations. This means you will have the opportunity to make a real impact on how our kitchen is structured and how it will develop in the future.

• The opportunity to influence kitchen systems, organisation and culture.

• Space to contribute creatively to in the restaurant.

• A close relationship with the management and kitchen team.

• Opportunity to grow as the restaurant and our hospitality group develop.

• Salary based on experience and qualifications.

We believe great restaurants are built when good food, strong systems, genuine hospitality and great people work together. If you love your craft, enjoy responsibility and want to help us build something stronger, we would love to meet you.

title: Data Scientist for Department of Biology
description:
We are Earth scientists who accumulate large data sets on the composition of sedimentary rocks in geologic time on modern sediments from throughout the world. Our ambition is to generate coupled interactive data sets, where data can be easily extracted, and compared with other literature data sets. What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s
chemical environment and the evolution of life. The position is based at the Department of Biology.

The position will run from February 1 2027 until June 30, 2029.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Studentermedhjælper søges til spændende og alsidige opgaver
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for både studerende og medarbejdere i Center for Socialt Arbejde på Professionshøjskolen Absalon? Vi søger en engageret og selvstændig studentermedhjælper, der har lyst til at løse forskellige administrative og udviklingsorienterede opgaver.

Absalon er en af landets seks professionshøjskoler og dækker geografisk Region Sjælland. Vi har et stærkt fokus på undervisning af høj kvalitet, studieengagement og regional forankring. Vi har uddannelser i syv byer, efter- og videreuddannelser i vækst og en stærk udvikling inden for anvendelsesorienteret forskning i samarbejde med praksis.

Din profil
Du skal arbejde med kvalitetssikring af undervisningsmaterialer, samt understøtte vores docent med forskellige forskningsrelaterede opgaver. Derfor søger vi dig, der både trives med strukturerede og detaljeorienterede opgaver, og samtidig er nysgerrig på at bidrage til udviklings- og forskningsarbejde. Du kan se dig selv i følgende:

Arbejdstilgang og ansvar. Vi ser gerne, at du har en positiv tilgang til dit arbejde og trives med at tage ansvar for egne opgaver. Du arbejder selvstændigt, er initiativrig og tør spørge ind, når noget er uklart. Samtidig har du blik for kvalitet og går grundigt til dine opgaver.

Struktur og detaljeorienteret. Du arbejder systematisk og struktureret og har sans for detaljer. Du trives med opgaver, der kræver fordybelse og grundighed, og du motiveres af at skabe orden, ensartethed og høj kvalitet i dit arbejde. Du kan bevare overblikket, også når du arbejder med større mængder materiale eller længerevarende opgaver.

Samarbejde og relationer. Du er imødekommende og samarbejdsorienteret og har lyst til at indgå i dialog med både undervisere, forskere og øvrige medarbejdere. Du er nysgerrig af natur og har mod på at sætte dig ind i nye fagområder og arbejdsopgaver.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

  • er studerende, gerne på en bacheloruddannelse

  • har gode skriftlige kompetencer og øje for sproglig kvalitet

  • har mod på at arbejde i forskellige IT-systemer som fx Outlook, Teams og litteraturdatabaser

  • trives med både rutineprægede og mere komplekse opgaver.


Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som studentermedhjælper i Center for Socialt Arbejde er din opgaver som her beskrevet:

Kvalitetssikre drejebøger og undervisningsmateriale. Frem til februar vil en væsentlig del af dine opgaver bestå i at gennemlæse og kvalitetssikre drejebøger til værkstedsdage. Du skal sikre ensartethed på tværs af materialerne, herunder opbygning, formatering, sprog og generel kvalitet. Opgaven kræver et godt blik for detaljer og evnen til at arbejde systematisk med større mængder materiale.

Understøtte forskningsarbejde. Fra februar forventes du primært at understøtte centerets docent i forskning. Opgaverne kan variere og kræver derfor fleksibilitet og selvstændighed. Du skal blandt andet bidrage til revidering og udarbejdelse af materialer, litteraturarbejde, dokumenthåndtering og andre opgaver relateret til forskningsprojekter.

Administration og daglig drift. Der kan forekomme forskellige administrative opgaver, som understøtter centerets daglige arbejde. Opgaverne kan eksempelvis omfatte mødebookinger, koordinering og praktisk understøttelse af aktiviteter og arrangementer.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af Center for Socialt Arbejde, som er fordelt pa? tre af Absalons campusser i Roskilde, Slagelse og Nykøbing Falster med ca. 60 fagligt dygtige og engagerede kolleger. Hver eneste dag arbejder vi med at uddanne fremtidens socialrådgivere i hele Region Sjælland og for at gøre nuværende socialrådgivere dygtigere.

Du får fast arbejdsplads i Roskilde og tilknyttes et engageret konsulentteam på flere medarbejdere, som også har arbejdsplads i Roskilde. Vi lægger vægt på samarbejde og videndeling og et uformelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til at lære og udvikle sig sammen. Vi værdsætter initiativ og hjælpsomhed, og sætter pris på et godt socialt fællesskab.

Sådan ansøger du

  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK).

  • Timelønnen udgør 145,91. kr. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 16%.

  • Stillingen er på 8-15 timer pr. uge, med start senest 1. november 2026 til udgangen af 2027.

  • Ansættelsessted er Campus Roskilde, Trekroner Forskerpark 4.

  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Special- og campuskonsulent, Laura Andersen på tlf. 7248 1836 eller laan@pha.dk

  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' på denne side senest den 4. oktober 2026. https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger

  • Vi forventer at afholdes samtaler tirsdag d. 6. oktober 2026.


Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

title: Warehouse Operative – Picking and Packing
description:
We are looking for a dedicated and reliable warehouse operative for our client, Bring, in Greve. The position primarily involves picking and packing outdoor equipment during daytime hours.

Your primary responsibilities will include picking and packing smaller outdoor products. You will pick the goods using an electric pallet truck and subsequently pack and prepare the orders for shipment. Most items are picked from floor level or from the second level, where a step ladder is available. In addition, you will carry out general warehouse and terminal duties.

We are looking for someone with a strong work ethic and the right attitude. You are reliable, responsible and willing to get stuck in, while also being able to work independently and proactively and contribute positively to a team. A forklift certificate is an advantage but not a requirement. Much of the work takes place at floor level or from the second level, so not having a forklift certificate should not be a barrier.

Previous warehouse or terminal experience is an advantage, but the most important thing is that you have the right attitude and are motivated to become part of the team.

The job does not involve heavy lifting on a regular basis. Most of the items are relatively small, but you should be comfortable with occasionally having to lift a box down when necessary. It is therefore an advantage if you are comfortable with physically active work and have a good level of physical fitness.

You will be employed on a full-time temporary basis, working Monday to Thursday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM and Friday from 8:00 AM to 3:30 PM. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible and work until 13 October 2026. Your salary will be in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will obtain one reference from a previous employer during the recruitment process. So don't wait – upload your application and CV today.

  • Koordinere og planlægge den daglige restaurantdrift

  • Bidrage til oplæring, sparring og udvikling af medarbejderne samt være med til at skabe et stærkt og engageret team

Vi tilbyder:

  • Job i en virksomhed med stor erfaring og kendskab til branchen

  • En kvalitetsbevidst arbejdsplads med professionelle ansatte

  • En virksomhed hvor der ikke er langt fra tanke til handling

  • En attraktiv lønpakke med pensionsordning

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og fordelagtige personalerabatter i hele koncernen

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har stor interesse for vin og gastronomi

  • Er en god teamplayer

  • Er smilende, udadvendt, serviceminded og gæsteorienteret

  • Arbejder med stort engagement og fleksibilitet

  • Har overblik i stressede situationer og er problemløsende

  • Har stor forståelse for at skabe helhedsoplevelser

Lyder det som noget for dig, så ansøg via dette link senest den 18. oktober 2026.

Bühlmann Hotels har flere unikke hoteller i Danmark. Hotelporteføljen byder urbane city hoteller og ikoniske boutiquehoteller. title: Restaurant Mad & Kaffe Frederiksberg is looking for a Sous Chef
description:
Mad & Kaffe Frederiksberg is looking for a skilled and ambitious Sous Chef to join our kitchen team and help deliver high-quality food experiences for our guests — always with a focus on craftsmanship, consistency, and great hospitality.

You will become part of a young and dedicated team where we challenge each other, work closely together, and create an environment with room for both responsibility and personal growth. Our kitchens are busy, dynamic, and fast-paced, so it’s important that you thrive under pressure, stay organized, and lead with calmness and precision — even during peak service.

We work with fresh, seasonal ingredients and make everything in-house. Passion for quality and attention to detail are at the core of everything we do.

About the role

As Sous Chef, you will play a key role in the daily operation of the kitchen and support the Head Chef in maintaining high standards across service, preparation, and team culture.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Daily kitchen operations and service management
• Quality control and ensuring consistency in every dish
• Ordering and stock management
• Preparation planning and kitchen organization
• Leading and motivating the team during your shifts
• Supporting and developing junior team members

About you

You are passionate about food, leadership, and teamwork. You enjoy taking responsibility and want to be part of a growing company where there is room to develop both professionally and personally.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from a similar leadership role in a professional kitchen
• Are confident working independently and making decisions under pressure
• Thrive in a fast-paced environment and stay focused during busy services
• Are flexible with working hours, including evenings and weekends
• Lead by example and take pride in delivering high standards every day
• Are a positive and reliable colleague with strong team spirit
• Bring energy, structure, and commitment to your work

What we offer

• A professional and exciting workplace with responsibility and trust
• A kitchen focused on quality ingredients and strong craftsmanship
• A dynamic everyday environment where no two days are the same
• Opportunities for both professional and personal development
• A supportive and social working culture
• Flexible scheduling
• Staff benefits at all Mad & Kaffe cafés

Apply

Please send your motivated application to our Head Chef, David Andersen.

title: R&D Engineer – Machining
description:
DAMRC is a research and development centre for advanced manufacturing. We are internationally recognised for our work in metal processing, and our job is to turn new technology into something Danish manufacturers can use on the shop floor.

You will work both in our own R&D centre in Herning, where trials can be run without stopping a production line, and out at the companies themselves, where the solution has to survive daily use.

We are now expanding the engineering team with two R&D Engineers.

Your role

As an R&D Engineer you will work on national and international research and development projects from the first idea through to implementation, at a high international technical level. Specifically, you will:

•     Drive the development and maturation of new machining technologies in our R&D centre

•     Play a central role in process and production optimisation for industrial customers

•     Work closely with cross-functional teams and industry partners

•     Contribute to technologies that support the green transition

•     Share what you find - with engineers, production managers and machine operators alike

Who we are looking for

We are filling two positions and they do not have to be identical profiles.

Essential

•     A degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering or equivalent

•     Real understanding of machining - the process itself, not just the theory around it

•     The ability to explain a technical result clearly to very different audiences, from design engineers to machine operators

•     Fluent English, written and spoken. Danish is not a requirement

Advantageous

•     Specialisation in materials engineering

•     Hands-on experience with material processing and machining techniques

•     Strong analytical skills and experience with trial design, measurement or data analysis

•     Strong IT skills and familiarity with current engineering tools and methods

Ambitious recent graduates are encouraged to apply. If you are early in your career we do not expect the experience - we expect curiosity and a willingness to get your hands dirty.

Eligibility. You must already be entitled to work in Denmark. We are not set up to handle work and residence permit applications, so we can only consider applicants who are citizens of the EU, EEA or Switzerland, or who already hold a valid Danish work permit.

What we offer

•     A high-technology research centre in strong growth, where you are invited to contribute both professionally and personally

•     Direct contact with our members and customers, and time spent inside companies most engineers never see from the inside

•     An innovative, supportive environment alongside highly skilled colleagues who share your interest in engineering

•     Work with technologies that drive the green agenda forward

Living in Herning

Interested in joining an international community in Denmark? Herning has a diverse expat network, and we will welcome you into it.

About DAMRC

DAMRC – Danish Advanced Manufacturing Research Center – is a leader in metal processing and is internationally recognised for ground-breaking innovation.

Our mission is to help Danish companies succeed through innovation and the use of the latest technology. We work in close collaboration with our members, which include several leading companies in metal processing and the machinery industry.

Since 2010 we have completed more than 400 industry projects.

We are a team of around 30 based at Industrivej Syd 17A, 7400 Herning, Denmark.

How to apply

We review applications as they arrive and will close the posting once we have found the right people, so there is no deadline — send yours when you are ready.

Send your application and CV to work@damrc.com with “R&D Engineer” in the subject line.

To hear more before applying, contact Rory Shaw (+45 2253 312/ros@damrc.com) or Sebastián Assain (+45 2222 5594/sea@damrc.com)

Your application and your personal data. We treat every application confidentially and process your personal data in accordance with the GDPR.

title: AI Manager (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
description:
Willst du KI in echten geschäftlichen Mehrwert für die DLG verwandeln? Als **AI Manager (m/w/d)** spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Group IT. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die KI‑Strategie der DLG weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen. In dieser Rolle treibst du nicht nur die Richtung und Umsetzung von KI‑Initiativen voran, sondern baust auch ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf und führst es. Du schaffst die Grundlage dafür, wie wir KI‑Lösungen entwickeln, skalieren und im gesamten Unternehmen betreiben.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

- Du definierst und verantwortest die KI‑Roadmap sowie das Use‑Case‑Portfolio über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.
- Du baust ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf, führst und entwickelst es weiter.
- Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und wirkungsvolle KI‑Lösungen.
- Du steuerst das Solution Design – von der Idee über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur Implementierung.
- Du etablierst Standards für Daten, Integrationen, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Responsible AI.
- Du arbeitest eng mit technischen Teams, externen Partnern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um Fortschritt und Qualität sicherzustellen.
- Du unterstützt Build-or-Buy‑Entscheidungen und sorgst für die Abstimmung mit den Enterprise‑Plattformen.

Profil

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und pragmatisch und erzielst Ergebnisse sowohl durch dein Team als auch durch deine eigene Expertise. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business und IT und weißt, wie man Richtung, Alignment und Momentum in einem komplexen Stakeholder‑Umfeld schafft.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du:

- nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden
- Erfahrung mit Governance, Priorisierung und funktionsübergreifenden Entscheidungen haben
- eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit sein, die motiviert, coacht und Engagement schafft
- strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeiten
- klar kommunizieren und komplexe Themen verständlich machen
- sicher in Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG erwartet dich eine spannende und wirkungsvolle Rolle in einem Unternehmen, in dem KI und Digitalisierung ganz oben auf der Agenda stehen.

Du kannst dich freuen auf:

- eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der KI‑Ausrichtung eines internationalen Unternehmens
- die Möglichkeit, eine neue KI‑Funktion innerhalb der DLG aufzubauen und zu führen
- ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Einfluss
- ein starkes professionelles Umfeld in IT, Daten und Digitalisierung
- persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und eine gesunde Work‑Life‑Balance

Kontakt

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung im PDF-Format über unser Bewerbungsportal unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

title: Enterprise Architect (m/w/d) (Software-Architect)
description:
DLG befindet sich auf einer ambitionierten digitalen Transformationsreise und entwickelt sich von einer fragmentierten, historisch gewachsenen IT-Landschaft hin zu einer modernen Architektur, die konsequent an geschäftlichen Fähigkeiten und Unternehmenszielen ausgerichtet ist. Als Enterprise Architect (m/w/d) spielst du eine zentrale Rolle dabei, die zukünftige Enterprise Architecture von DLG zu definieren und starke, unternehmensweite Architekturpraktiken zu etablieren.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Hauptverantwortung für unser Enterprise‑Architecture‑Repository und fungierst als zentrale Ansprechperson, die Transparenz über die aktuelle sowie die zukünftige Applikationslandschaft sicherstellt. In dieser Rolle agierst du als vertrauenswürdige Beratungsperson für Group IT und die Fachbereiche und treibst die architektonische Governance, Prioritäten und strategische Ausrichtung voran.

Du leitest Initiativen zur Vereinfachung, Modernisierung und Verbesserung der Interoperabilität in unseren Geschäftsbereichen Landwirtschaft, Tierernährung, Energie und Wohnen – mit einem starken Fokus auf die nahtlose Integration zwischen Anwendungen und unserer unternehmensweiten Datenplattform**.**

In dieser Rolle wirst du:

- DLGs Zielarchitektur und Architekturprinzipien definieren und weiterentwickeln – und sicherstellen, dass sie konsequent mit der Geschäftsstrategie abgestimmt sind.
- Die Modernisierungsreise von Legacy‑Systemen hin zu einer composable Architecture vorantreiben, die auf einer starken Integrationsplattform basiert.
- Eine enge Integration zwischen Anwendungen und Plattformen sicherstellen – einschließlich der unternehmensweiten Datenplattform.
- Architekturprinzipien, Standards und Roadmaps definieren und steuern, abgestimmt auf die strategischen Prioritäten der DLG.
- Datengetriebene Architekturinitiativen unterstützen.
- Architektur-Governance und domänenübergreifende Abstimmung zwischen Group IT und den Geschäftsbereichen fördern.
- ERP‑, Daten‑, Integrations‑, Plattform‑ und KI‑Teams in Richtung der Zielarchitektur begleiten.

Profil

- Umfassende Erfahrung in Enterprise‑, Lösungs‑ oder Domänenarchitektur in großen oder komplexen Organisationen
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Architektur-Frameworks wie TOGAF oder SABSA – und die Fähigkeit, sie pragmatisch zur Erzielung geschäftlicher Ergebnisse einzusetzen
- Tiefes Verständnis von Enterprise Architecture, Integrationsmustern, modernen Plattformen und komplexen IT‑Landschaften
- Erfahrung mit ERP‑Systemen (idealerweise SAP), CRM sowie API‑/Event‑getriebenen Integrationen
- Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise‑Architecture‑Management‑Lösungen, idealerweise LeanIX
- Analytische, strukturierte und pragmatische Denkweise, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Konzepte zu vereinfachen
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (Dänisch und/oder Deutsch sind ein Plus)

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG übernimmst du eine strategische Rolle mit erheblichem Einfluss auf die zukünftige Digital‑ & IT‑Landschaft. Du erhältst ein klares Mandat, technologische Entscheidungen, Investitionsprioritäten und die übergeordnete architektonische Ausrichtung im gesamten Unternehmen mitzugestalten.

Du arbeitest eng mit dem CIO, der Group‑IT‑Führung sowie einer Vielzahl von Business‑Stakeholdern zusammen – in einer Organisation, in der Architektur auf Executive‑Level priorisiert und unterstützt wird.

Dich erwartet ein dynamisches, internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit kompetenten Kolleg*innen aus Architektur, Entwicklung und den Geschäftsbereichen. Zudem profitierst du von einem flexiblen Arbeitsort, mit der Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro in Fredericia oder Flensburg sowie anteilig mobil zu arbeiten.

Weitere Informationen

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung!

Bitte lade deine Bewerbung auf Englisch als PDF in unserem Bewerbungsportal hoch und teile uns dabei deine Gehaltsvorstellung sowie deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin mit.

title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals
description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor / Associate Professor, and Curator of Mammals at Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark wishes to appoint a Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals (mammalia) with a great vision for natural history museums in a changing world. Duties are divided equally between collection-based research and other museum duties including curation of the mammal collections, research-based teaching and supervision of students, public engagement work, and to act as the museum's liaison with relevant Danish natural history communities. The successful applicant will be expected to establish and develop an externally funded collection-based research programme/group and publish in influential journals. We particularly encourage applications from applicants with a collection-based research specialization on mammalogy. The successful applicant will be expected to curate the museum’s historically important mammal collections (56.000 specimens) requiring a thorough understanding and practical knowledge of mammal classification. We value collaboration across disciplines and professions. All applicants are expected to demonstrate interdisciplinary thinking and a commitment to working together to create solutions to global challenges. This also goes for collection work. Curators develop the collections that they are responsible for through research, field work, loan activities, digitization, acting as scientific host for visiting researchers, and increasing accessibility for everyone. This curatorial position in Mammalogy at the Natural History Museum Denmark will be filled at either the Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level. All curators at the Natural History Museum Denmark are expected to take a leading role in society as advocates for science and nature, creating impact at all levels while actively promoting the museum’s Vision and Values (https://snm.dk/en/about-museum). Further details of qualifications required for appointment at the museum are detailed below.

The position is available starting March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Qualifications
Tenure-track assistant professor
Applicants at the tenure track assistant professor level are expected to have an academic record demonstrating the potential to deliver high profile internationally competitive research in the area of specialization. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have experience with collection-based research. Previous experience curating natural history collections and university teaching experience would be advantageous but is not a requirement at the time of hiring for tenure-track assistant professors. Documented interest in and experience with public engagement and community-based activities is expected. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar institution is an advantage.

Associate professor
Applicants at the associate professor level are expected to have a strong publication record in high-level, international, peer-reviewed venues in the area of specialization and a track record of successful external research funding. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have significant experience with collection-based research. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar is expected. Curatorial expertise and considerable previous experience and impact with curating and developing natural history collections is required at associate professor level. Broad experience and a compelling vision for public engagement and community-based activities is essential. Candidates are also required to have documented university-level competencies in delivering high-quality undergraduate/graduate teaching and must be able to explain and reflect upon their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

Assessment of applicants
Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research as well as their curatorial experience and potential to curate one or more of the museum’s collections. Teaching and public engagement qualifications and experience will be considered according to career level. The overall fit for the Natural History Museum will also be considered.
Ideal applicants will have the following qualifications:

  • An outstanding reputation for high-quality research within Mammalogy
  • A record of scientific use of museum collections and/or data
  • A proven track record of interdisciplinary research
  • Scientific expertise that ensures ability to curate Mammalia collections held by the museum
  • Curatorial experience improving and developing natural history collections
  • Experience from a natural history museum or similar
  • Participation in national and international museum collaborations through organizations and programs.
  • A vision for how digital, genomic, and other new technologies will drive advances in natural history science
  • Ability to work at a strategic level
  • A track record of public engagement and creating impact beyond academia
  • Experience working on museum exhibitions, interpretation, and/or public engagement
  • Experience in fundraising and ability to attract research funding from external sources for research, digitization and collection development.
  • Supportive and collaborative people skills and commitment to an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and respect for everyone with equality and opportunity for all
  • A passion for the vision and values of the Natural History Museum Denmark
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Confidence in ability to provide advocacy for the museum with multiple stakeholders
University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor/associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.
For tenure-track assistant professors
For associate professors

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

Information on the tenure-track programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period, tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

About the Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark is the Danish national museum for nature. We work to empower citizens to connect with nature with the aim to create positive change for people and planet. We want to inspire, engage, and enable people to enjoy, understand, and care for the diversity of the natural world. The impact of climate change and anthropogenic forces on biodiversity has reached a critical point. We firmly believe that natural history museums can and should play a key role towards a more sustainable relationship with nature. We are opening a new Danish national museum for nature in spring 2027. One big museum site, in the Botanical Garden, in the centre of Copenhagen, will host state-of-the-art laboratories, outstanding research collections, new public galleries, and combined facilities for programming, education, and citizen science. It is an ambition for the museum to enhance natural history and inspire curiosity, knowledge, and empowerment for the future. The Botanical Garden was founded in 1600, and the museum’s collections date back to Ole Worm’s Cabinet of Curiosities from around 1620. With 14 million preserved specimens and living plants of 8,000 different species in the Botanical Garden, it is the largest museum collection in Denmark. It covers our planetary history with botanical, zoological, and geological specimens from all over the world. Read more about the Mammalia collection here.

The Natural History Museum Denmark is part of the University of Copenhagen, which was founded in 1479 and is the largest university in Denmark. Read more about the museum here.
Inquiries about the position can be made to Museum Director Nina Rønsted (e-mail: nronsted@snm.ku.dk).

Affirmative action
The Natural History Museum Denmark is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disabled status. We are actively promoting a strategy to improve the gender balance among scientific staff. Copenhagen is a highly diverse and international Scandinavian capital with a green profile. Education is free and childcare is subsidized. Public transport is well developed, and most Copenhageners take their bike to work. There are lots of green areas in and around Copenhagen, the water in the harbor is clean enough for swimming, and the city has multiple museums and other cultural venues.

Terms of employment
Employment is as tenure-track assistant professor/associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The successful applicant is expected to take Danish lessons if there is no prior knowledge of Danish language. The International Office at the University of Copenhagen can help.
This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPHs extensive support for international researchers here

  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:

title: Køkkenmedarbejder søges til Klax Greve, integreret institution
description:
Kan du lide at skabe måltider, der både ser indbydende ud og smager godt – og har du samtidig sans for orden, hygiejne og et køkken, der står flot, når dagen er slut?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

I Klax Greve søger vi en køkkenmedarbejder til en stilling på 20–25 timer om ugen. Stillingen er i første omgang et vikariat med mulighed for fastansættelse.

Et køkken, hvor det gode måltid er i centrum

Du bliver en del af et flot og velfungerende køkken, hvor maden til børnene leveres af Fru Hansens Kælder, som står for en økologisk og sund frokostordning til daginstitutioner.

Det betyder, at du ikke skal stå for den store madproduktion fra bunden. I stedet modtager vi måltidskasser med delvist tilberedte råvarer og retter, som er nemme at gøre klar.

Din opgave bliver at få det sidste til at ske.

Du skal tilberede maden, gøre den appetitlig og indbydende for børnene og sørge for, at måltiderne bliver serveret med glæde og omtanke.

Det handler ikke kun om at sætte mad på bordet. Det handler også om at skabe gode måltidsoplevelser for børnene.

Du har øje for detaljen

Når dagens måltid er serveret, sørger du for, at køkkenet igen står rent, ryddeligt og indbydende.

Du arbejder struktureret og har blik for, at alt er på plads, så næste dags forberedelser kan begynde, når du møder ind igen.

Vi forventer derfor, at du:

  • har gyldigt hygiejnebevis

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • har sans for orden, rengøring og fødevaresikkerhed

  • kan gøre maden indbydende og appetitlig

  • tager ansvar for, at køkkenet fungerer godt i hverdagen

  • møder børn og kolleger med et smil og en positiv tilgang

-Og så skal du selvfølgelig kunne lide børn

Du behøver ikke være pædagog for at arbejde hos os.

Men hvis du synes, at børn er fantastiske, og du har lyst til at være en del af deres hverdag, så er det et rigtig godt match.

Hos Klax er køkkenet nemlig også en del af det pædagogiske miljø. Børnene skal kunne mærke, at maden er lavet til dem – og måske bliver du også den, der får en lille snak med et barn, der lige kommer forbi køkkenet.

Vi tilbyder

  • en stilling på 20–25 timer om ugen

  • et vikariat med mulighed for fastansættelse

  • et flot og velfungerende køkken

  • gode råvarer og en økologisk frokostordning

  • en arbejdsplads, hvor du bliver en vigtig del af børnenes hverdag

  • kolleger, der arbejder for at skabe gode dage for børnene

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning til os – vi glæder os til at møde dig!

Vi holder løbende samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigt så du kan få mulighed for at tale med os.

description:
We are Earth scientists who accumulate large data sets on the composition of sedimentary rocks in geologic time on modern sediments from throughout the world. Our ambition is to generate coupled interactive data sets, where data can be easily extracted, and compared with other literature data sets. What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s
chemical environment and the evolution of life. The position is based at the Department of Biology.

The position will run from February 1 2027 until June 30, 2029.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals
description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor / Associate Professor, and Curator of Mammals at Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark wishes to appoint a Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals (mammalia) with a great vision for natural history museums in a changing world. Duties are divided equally between collection-based research and other museum duties including curation of the mammal collections, research-based teaching and supervision of students, public engagement work, and to act as the museum's liaison with relevant Danish natural history communities. The successful applicant will be expected to establish and develop an externally funded collection-based research programme/group and publish in influential journals. We particularly encourage applications from applicants with a collection-based research specialization on mammalogy. The successful applicant will be expected to curate the museum’s historically important mammal collections (56.000 specimens) requiring a thorough understanding and practical knowledge of mammal classification. We value collaboration across disciplines and professions. All applicants are expected to demonstrate interdisciplinary thinking and a commitment to working together to create solutions to global challenges. This also goes for collection work. Curators develop the collections that they are responsible for through research, field work, loan activities, digitization, acting as scientific host for visiting researchers, and increasing accessibility for everyone. This curatorial position in Mammalogy at the Natural History Museum Denmark will be filled at either the Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level. All curators at the Natural History Museum Denmark are expected to take a leading role in society as advocates for science and nature, creating impact at all levels while actively promoting the museum’s Vision and Values (https://snm.dk/en/about-museum). Further details of qualifications required for appointment at the museum are detailed below.

The position is available starting March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Qualifications
Tenure-track assistant professor
Applicants at the tenure track assistant professor level are expected to have an academic record demonstrating the potential to deliver high profile internationally competitive research in the area of specialization. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have experience with collection-based research. Previous experience curating natural history collections and university teaching experience would be advantageous but is not a requirement at the time of hiring for tenure-track assistant professors. Documented interest in and experience with public engagement and community-based activities is expected. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar institution is an advantage.

Associate professor
Applicants at the associate professor level are expected to have a strong publication record in high-level, international, peer-reviewed venues in the area of specialization and a track record of successful external research funding. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have significant experience with collection-based research. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar is expected. Curatorial expertise and considerable previous experience and impact with curating and developing natural history collections is required at associate professor level. Broad experience and a compelling vision for public engagement and community-based activities is essential. Candidates are also required to have documented university-level competencies in delivering high-quality undergraduate/graduate teaching and must be able to explain and reflect upon their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

Assessment of applicants
Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research as well as their curatorial experience and potential to curate one or more of the museum’s collections. Teaching and public engagement qualifications and experience will be considered according to career level. The overall fit for the Natural History Museum will also be considered.
Ideal applicants will have the following qualifications:

  • An outstanding reputation for high-quality research within Mammalogy
  • A record of scientific use of museum collections and/or data
  • A proven track record of interdisciplinary research
  • Scientific expertise that ensures ability to curate Mammalia collections held by the museum
  • Curatorial experience improving and developing natural history collections
  • Experience from a natural history museum or similar
  • Participation in national and international museum collaborations through organizations and programs.
  • A vision for how digital, genomic, and other new technologies will drive advances in natural history science
  • Ability to work at a strategic level
  • A track record of public engagement and creating impact beyond academia
  • Experience working on museum exhibitions, interpretation, and/or public engagement
  • Experience in fundraising and ability to attract research funding from external sources for research, digitization and collection development.
  • Supportive and collaborative people skills and commitment to an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and respect for everyone with equality and opportunity for all
  • A passion for the vision and values of the Natural History Museum Denmark
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Confidence in ability to provide advocacy for the museum with multiple stakeholders
University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor/associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.
For tenure-track assistant professors
For associate professors

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

Information on the tenure-track programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period, tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

About the Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark is the Danish national museum for nature. We work to empower citizens to connect with nature with the aim to create positive change for people and planet. We want to inspire, engage, and enable people to enjoy, understand, and care for the diversity of the natural world. The impact of climate change and anthropogenic forces on biodiversity has reached a critical point. We firmly believe that natural history museums can and should play a key role towards a more sustainable relationship with nature. We are opening a new Danish national museum for nature in spring 2027. One big museum site, in the Botanical Garden, in the centre of Copenhagen, will host state-of-the-art laboratories, outstanding research collections, new public galleries, and combined facilities for programming, education, and citizen science. It is an ambition for the museum to enhance natural history and inspire curiosity, knowledge, and empowerment for the future. The Botanical Garden was founded in 1600, and the museum’s collections date back to Ole Worm’s Cabinet of Curiosities from around 1620. With 14 million preserved specimens and living plants of 8,000 different species in the Botanical Garden, it is the largest museum collection in Denmark. It covers our planetary history with botanical, zoological, and geological specimens from all over the world. Read more about the Mammalia collection here.

The Natural History Museum Denmark is part of the University of Copenhagen, which was founded in 1479 and is the largest university in Denmark. Read more about the museum here.
Inquiries about the position can be made to Museum Director Nina Rønsted (e-mail: nronsted@snm.ku.dk).

Affirmative action
The Natural History Museum Denmark is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disabled status. We are actively promoting a strategy to improve the gender balance among scientific staff. Copenhagen is a highly diverse and international Scandinavian capital with a green profile. Education is free and childcare is subsidized. Public transport is well developed, and most Copenhageners take their bike to work. There are lots of green areas in and around Copenhagen, the water in the harbor is clean enough for swimming, and the city has multiple museums and other cultural venues.

Terms of employment
Employment is as tenure-track assistant professor/associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The successful applicant is expected to take Danish lessons if there is no prior knowledge of Danish language. The International Office at the University of Copenhagen can help.
This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPHs extensive support for international researchers here

How to apply
The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae documenting:
    • Previous positions at museums, universities, or other research or cultural institutions
    • Fundraising experience
    • International network and relations
    • Curatorial experience (curation of collections)
    • Public engagement activities, i.e. citizen science projects, exhibitions, popular lectures or other relevant activities
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc- and MSc-students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Diplomas (MSc and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, impact, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is November 2 2026 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. We work thoroughly with this process. Several professionals from different fields must be involved. Therefore, we will not be ready for interviews until February 2027.

You can read about the recruitment process here.

Please refer to the following no. in future communication: 211-0260/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor and Curator of Mammals/211-0765/26-2E Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals

title: Material Coordinator

We are part of the NorSea Group - a global provider of base operations and full service logistics solutions with 50 years of experience.

NorSea Group is owned by one of the world’s largest maritime industrial group, Wilhelmsen. As an experienced and reliable one-stop-shop, we at NorSea Denmark aim to set new industry standards for efficiency and safety. We deliver all types of logistics and base solutions to the offshore sector. With a deep understanding of our customers’ commercial interests and needs, we innovate safe and profitable solutions.
