title: Head of Safety
description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?

If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as our Head of Safety at Esrange Space Center.

At Esrange Space Center, safety is fundamental to everything we do. Our operations include sounding rocket and balloon launches, rocket testing, and the development of orbital launch capabilities – activities that place high demands on safety, coordination and regulatory compliance.

As Head of Safety, you will lead and coordinate the overall safety work at Esrange Space Center. Your mission is to ensure a safe environment for employees, customers, contractors, visitors and the public across operations that include rocket and balloon launches, testing and future orbital launch activities.

You will set the frameworks and requirements for our safety work and lead experts within areas such as range safety, flight and campaign safety, occupational health and safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness. This is a strategic role with a strong operational focus, significant decision-making authority, and close collaboration with internal teams, authorities, and local stakeholders.

REQUIREMENTS

    A relevant degree in engineering, safety, risk management, HSE or fire protection, or equivalent experience.
    At least five years of safety or HSE experience from a regulated industrial or operational environment.
    Experience leading specialists and coordinating safety across several functions.
    Experience developing and maintaining safety management systems.
    Strong knowledge of risk management, emergency preparedness, and regulatory compliance.
    Experience working with authorities, permits, and external stakeholders.
    Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Experience from aviation, airports, aerospace, defence or another safety-critical field is highly valued. Knowledge of flight safety, airspace coordination, Seveso, explosive materials, ADR, or systematic fire protection is an advantage.

You are an analytical and confident leader who remains calm under pressure. You combine structure and integrity with a practical approach and are comfortable making difficult decisions when safety is at stake. You also know how to build trust, challenge unsafe practices, and turn requirements into effective action.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Lead and develop the overall safety function and Safety Management System at Esrange.
    Ensure clear safety frameworks, processes, and responsibilities.
    Coordinate the Esrange Safety Board and safety preparations for launches, tests and campaigns.
    Lead and coordinate safety specialists across range safety, flight safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness.
    Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, permits and authority requirements.
    Develop the site-wide crisis and emergency response organization, including training and exercises.
    Coordinate airspace, impact-area and public-safety matters with authorities and external stakeholders.
    Oversee incident management, safety planning, budgeting and continuous improvement.

WE OFFER YOU

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center outside of Kiruna.

  

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

This position is security-sensitive and requires approved security vetting and background check in accordance with the protective security act. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.

WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

title: Piping Team Leader
description:

Skills and Competencies

· Leadership and team management skills

title: Senior Automation  Engineer -SCADA
description:
Job Title: Senior Automation Engineer SCADA

About the Role: We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Automation Engineer SCADA to ensure the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of our SCADA networks and Substation Automation Systems (SAS). The ideal candidate will be a technical expert capable of leading projects from bay to entire substation SAS/SCADA design and commissioning.

Key Responsibilities & Core Requirements:

    HVAC Substation Automation: Core Knowledge and Hands-on experience in HVAC Substation Automation.
    System & Network Mastery: Extensive SCADA, RTU, PLC, Networking, and Protocol expertise. Familiarity with multi-vendor systems (such as ABB RTU, Schneider PACiS, or MicroSCADA) and PLC programming is highly valued.

This must include IED Communication configuration, signal testing, SCADA Configuration, Data concentrator configuration, along with Protocol conversion knowledge and hands-on experience.

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will provide expert advice on SAS/SCADA best trends, taking on a crucial role in project scoping, supervision, and the management of major SCADA project works. title: Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology

Quantitative Excel Modelling

Develop and maintain Excel-based calculation models and prototypes for process yields, quantities, volumes, pricing, costs, revenues and other project-related calculations.

Scenario & Sensitivity Analysis

Prepare scenario, sensitivity and comparative calculations to assess how changes in operational assumptions may affect commercial outcomes, costs, risks and project viability.

Process & Technical Data Analysis

Research and analyze information relating to thermolysis/pyrolysis processes, feedstocks, process outputs and relevant by-products, and incorporate relevant data into commercial and financial models.

Translate technical and operational assumptions into practical commercial models, business cases, analyses and presentations suitable for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Prepare and maintain technical, commercial and administrative documentation, reports, presentations, visual materials and other project-related content.

Financial Administration

Support general financial administration, preliminary bookkeeping, invoice verification, cost tracking and project budget follow-ups.

Digital & Information Management

Maintain and organize project information through SharePoint and other digital systems, and assist with maintaining the company's website and LinkedIn presence.

Operational & Management Support

Provide direct administrative and operational support to company management and act as a coordination point for information flow between management, project teams and external contacts.

Qualifications & Experience

    Relevant professional experience in project coordination, business analysis, business administration, operations, financial administration or a related field.

    Strong organizational, administrative and project coordination skills.
    Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and follow up on details.

title: Compliance Model Validator | Swedbank
description:
Are you passionate about financial crime risk models?In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

• Perform independent model validations of models primarily used in the financial crime risk area, including both rule-based and machine learning models.

• Assess model risk from the aspects of model objective, design and construction, assumptions and limitations, data, implementation, model governance, and ongoing performance monitoring.

• Deliver high quality and value adding model validation reports which support effective and efficient model development and enhancements of the model risk management in the 1LoD.

• Proactively challenge the 1LoD in its activities to develop, maintain and monitor its models in a constructive and evidence-based manner, focusing on whether these models adequately mitigate the compliance risks in scope.

• Be part of our compliance continuous maturity journey and take an active role in supporting the bank in strengthening the tools and models to combat financial crime.

What is needed in this role:

• A degree in a quantitative field e.g. computer science, data science, data engineering, statistics, mathematics, or economics.

• Experience in data assembling and analysis of large datasets.

• Experience in SQL, querying and manipulating large databases.

• Experience in rule-based and machine learning models (both supervised and unsupervised learning), including relevant programming skills in Python.

• Experience from working with Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision trees, Random Forest, and Isolation Forest.

• Experience from working in Microsoft Azure.

• Familiarity with the retail banking industry, products and services offered, its compliance and operational risks, and preferably model risk management for AML/CTF/FS models.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms to a non-technical audience, and to clearly articulate and defend validation findings, methodologies in discussions with stakeholders and senior management.

• Excellent collaboration skills, enabling effective teamwork and good team spirit.

• Strong self-leadership, including the ability to drive and complete tasks independently and deliver to tight timelines.

• Proactive, engaged, and motivated to continuously learn and deepen your expertise in model risk management and model validation.

• Excellent communication skills in both oral and written English.

• Ready to enjoy working in an international environment with colleagues based in multiple locations.

With us, you can experience:

    

Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

    

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

    

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

    

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

    

Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden.

title: HR Specialist
description:
Be part of Clavister’s journey to secure the digital world! We are looking for an HR Specialist who wants to take an active role across the employee lifecycle and help us deliver effective, people-focused and scalable HR practices.

We apply Agile HR principles, working closely with the organisation, learning through feedback and data, and continuously adapting our people practices as our needs evolve. This is a broad and hands-on HR role for someone who enjoys combining people interaction with structure, independent responsibility and continuous improvement.

About Clavister

Clavister is a leading European cybersecurity company founded in 1997, headquartered in Örnsköldsvik, offering a wide range of cybersecurity solutions, including network firewalls, identity management, cloud security, machine learning and AI.

Today, we focus on four main customer segments: the Public Sector, Critical Infrastructure, Defence and Telecommunications. Together with our partners and distributors, Clavister’s hardware and software are widely deployed and used by customers in more than 100 countries.

The Role

As HR Specialist, you will work closely with our Head of HR. You will independently manage and coordinate defined HR processes and support employees and leaders throughout the employee lifecycle.

You will have a broad role spanning recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, HR administration and data, work environment activities and day-to-day HR support. You will be responsible for ensuring that the processes within your area are well structured, professionally delivered and continuously improved.

This is a role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, creating structure and making sure things get done, while providing a professional and positive experience for candidates, employees and People Leads.

Key areas of responsibility

    

Manage recruitment processes, including candidate communication, interview coordination and recruitment administration

    

Coordinate and continuously improve onboarding and offboarding processes

    

Coordinate activities, documentation and follow-up related to Systematic Work Environment (SAM) Management and the Safety Committee

    

Maintain accurate employee information, HR systems, documentation and records

You will also contribute to

    

Provide HR support to employees and People Leads, handling routine matters and working together with the Head of HR on more complex questions

    

Prepare and validate employee and compensation data for reporting, analysis and recurring HR processes

    

Support recurring HR activities related to engagement, communication, performance and employee development

    

Support personnel security activities throughout the employee lifecycle

    

Work closely with employees and People Leads to understand needs, gather feedback and improve HR practices

Across all these areas, you will work with an Agile HR mindset, staying close to the organisation, learning from feedback and continuously improving our processes, tools and ways of working.

The person we are looking for

Trust is our foundation, and how you work with people matters to us. We are looking for someone who combines a genuine interest in people with the structure and drive to take ownership and get things done.

You have experience working with HR and independently managing defined HR activities or processes. You understand the employee lifecycle, are comfortable managing several priorities at once, and communicate confidently in both Swedish and English.

We believe you will thrive at Clavister if you:

    

Care about people and take pride in creating a positive and professional experience for others

    

Collaborate openly, build strong relationships and enjoy working closely with employees and leaders

    

Show bravery by taking initiative, asking questions and challenging ways of working when you see an opportunity to improve

    

Innovate by being curious and looking for smarter ways of working, including how technology can improve everyday HR

    

Keep growing by seeking feedback, learning and adapting as the needs of our people and organisation evolve

    

Take ownership of your work while having the judgement to recognise when something should be discussed or escalated

You are structured and reliable and comfortable working iteratively, learning from feedback and adjusting along the way. You understand when consistency and structure are important and when a simpler, more flexible approach creates greater value.

Extra points for

Experience in one or more of the following is an advantage:

    

Recruitment and onboarding

    

Swedish work environment processes and employment practices

    

HR systems, employee data or HR reporting

    

HR analytics

    

Agile HR or working in an agile organisation

    

Technology, international or regulated organisations

We will continuously review and interview qualified applicants.

title: Product Engineering Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Realized Loss Data and Estimation

description:

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.



We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.



We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. title: Senior Strategic Advisor to Tech Strategy & Enablement

description:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Why Doktor.se

Doktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.

We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows — and that footprint is growing fast. AI is a working tool here, not a buzzword. We use it daily, we expect you to as well, and we hire people who treat it as a force multiplier.

What you'll do

Our data platform works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We have data scattered across Postgres databases, Amplitude, S3 file dumps, and a tangle of Python jobs that move it around. The reports get built and the business runs on them. But trust is brittle, reconciliation is too manual, and the foundations need work before we can scale to where we're going.

We need someone who can help us rebuild this — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where the warehouse is clean and the pipelines just run, this isn't it. If you want to redesign a data platform from foundations up, with real ownership and the leverage to make it good, here's what you'd own:

• Reshape the data foundations — multi-tenancy, retention, and data contracts with backend services.

• Decide what the warehouse actually is: self-hosted Postgres + dbt, managed Snowflake or BigQuery, or something else. You'll shape this.

• Unify three data sources that don't currently talk to each other: our operational databases, Amplitude product analytics, and a long tail of S3-based partner integrations.

• Build observability into the platform — lineage, freshness, and alerting that actually means something.

• Own reporting that finance, operations, and the board rely on. Make those reports trustworthy by design, not by manual reconciliation.

• Work directly with backend, product, and finance teams. You're not a service desk — you're a peer who shapes how data gets produced upstream, not just consumed downstream.

• Use AI aggressively for pipeline boilerplate, schema generation, transformation logic, and exploratory analysis — the same discipline we hold ourselves to.

You'll be part of a small data engineering team. That's a lot of ownership and not a lot of cover. The right person sees that as opportunity.

What we're looking for

• You've designed and run data platforms in production — not just written DAGs. You've thought about what to build vs buy, where transformations belong, and how to keep schemas honest as products evolve.

• You're fluent in Python and SQL, with strong opinions about how Postgres should be used as a warehouse (and when it shouldn't).

• You've used dbt or equivalent in a real environment and understand data modelling — staging, marts, tests.

• You have working knowledge of one or more managed warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and can evaluate them honestly against self-hosted options.

• You're comfortable with orchestration tools — Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, whichever — and know what an orchestrator is for.

• You think about data contracts as a product problem, not just a pipeline problem, and can make that case to backend engineers.

• You use AI in your daily work and can talk about how. If your answer is "I haven't really tried it yet," this isn't the role.

• Healthcare data experience is a plus. GDPR fluency is expected. Patientdatalagen familiarity is a bonus.

• You have a relevant university degree or equivalent experience.

Tech stack

• Sources: Postgres (operational), Amplitude (events), S3 (integrations and dumps)

• Languages: Python, SQL

• Cloud: AWS, multi-account

• Warehouse: Postgres today, open question for tomorrow

• Transformation: likely dbt going forward

• Orchestration: open question — you'll shape this

• AI: Claude and OpenAI in our daily workflow

What we offer

• Real influence. The data platform is being rebuilt and you're at the centre of it.

• Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers — your work is visible, not lost in a machine.

• Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.

• Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.

Practical details

• Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.

• Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.

• Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.

• Language: You'll be working with our entire org so Swedish is a strong plus, but English is our working language within tech.

• Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.

We handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

title: Senior Engineer - HVDC Control System, Platform & Tools
description:
Job Description Summary

Become part of a winning team and help deliver the green energy transition. As electricity demand grows and transmission systems evolve, HVDC technology is becoming increasingly important in enabling the reliable integration of renewable power. At the centre of these systems are the control, software, and platform technologies that support safe, efficient, and high-performance operation.

GE Vernova is looking for an experienced Senior Engineer - HVDC Control System, Platform & Tools to join our HVDC NPI team. This senior role sits at the heart of next-generation R&D and new product introduction, driving innovation across embedded systems, software platforms, industrial communication technologies, and network and cyber architectures. You will provide technical authority, lead complex engineering initiatives, and support the development of the tools and platforms that underpin future HVDC systems.Job Description

Key Responsibilities

    Provide technical authority to NPI development teams working across embedded software, IEC-61850 PC-based applications, full stack web applications, and network and cyber architecture
    Participate in design reviews for components, subassemblies, and key engineering deliverables during tendering and contract execution
    Identify, develop, evaluate, and introduce engineering solutions that support business needs and market-winning proposals
    Provide technical direction to projects during execution and support product, supplier, manufacturing, and field issue resolution
    Guide teams on specification, design, architecture, testing, user documentation, and engineering best practice
    Develop design practices, design guides, and support Design FMEAs, RCA, 5-Why, and 8-D activities as part of NPI development
    Represent GE Vernova externally in conferences, industry bodies, and academic collaborations, and provide technical guidance in customer or supplier engagements where required
    Support structured technical training, mentoring, lessons learned, and capability development across the HVDC organisation
    Work closely with ITO, OTR, Technology, and Consulting Engineers to strengthen design quality, competency frameworks, and cross-functional collaboration

Required Qualifications and Experience

    Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
    Strong hands-on experience in embedded software, desktop applications, full stack web applications, communication systems, or cybersecurity-related technologies
    Expert knowledge of software development processes, including Agile development methodology
    Experience acting as technical lead for NPI development programmes
    Strong understanding of operating systems, including real-time operating systems such as VxWorks, RT Linux, or QNX, and desktop operating systems such as Linux, Unix, or Windows
    Working knowledge of industrial protocols such as IEC-61850, IEC-104, DNP3, and Modbus
    Very good understanding of the ISO OSI model and communication layers
    Expert knowledge of processor and hardware technologies such as general-purpose processors, DSPs, FPGAs, and SoCs
    Sound knowledge of computing technologies and backplanes such as PCIe, VPX, and SOSA
    Good understanding of network and cyber architectures within industrial automation control systems

Preferred Qualifications

    Strong interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills
    Problem analysis and resolution capability
    Ability to maintain engineering integrity in demanding situations
    Lean experience
    Knowledge of HVDC converter operation theory and associated power electronics
    Knowledge of HVDC power system operations and control and protection theory
    Development experience using MATLAB/Simulink
    Hands-on experience with IEC-61850 SCT/ICT tools and data model development
    Awareness of IEC-62443 cybersecurity standards

We do not expect applicants to meet all of the requirements listed. If your skills, experience, and strengths align with several key aspects of the role, we encourage you to apply.

Why Join GE Vernova

This role offers the opportunity to influence the digital and technical foundations of next-generation HVDC systems. You will work across software, communications, automation, and power system technologies, helping to deliver innovative solutions that support the global energy transition.

Our Culture

Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.

Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.

Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!

We're determined to be the best place to grow

We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.

title: Work from Home: Norwegian-Speaking Customer Service Representative  Sikom
description:

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help shape and mature the architecture within a Data Analytics domain where data, integration, and business needs need to work together over time. In this role, you combine strategic architecture leadership with hands-on design work to create sustainable target states, clear models, and strong governance.

You will work closely with managers, project leads, product owners, and other stakeholders to guide decisions and build long-term architectural capability. A central part of the assignment is also to coach internal team members and strengthen the organization’s own architecture competence. This is a strong opportunity for you who enjoy influencing both direction and execution in a large-scale analytics environment.

Job Description

    You will establish and develop architecture, information patterns, and integration patterns within the Data Analytics domain.
    You will design data structures, information models, data models, and governance processes aligned with business needs and long-term objectives.
    You will define integration structures and architectural principles that support sustainable solutions.
    You will create, update, and maintain architectural documentation, target states, and integration flows.
    You will contribute to the development of the overall system landscape architecture.
    You will provide architectural guidance to managers, project leads, product owners, and domain stakeholders.
    You will support architectural governance and help ensure alignment with established standards and principles.
    You will mentor and coach internal team members to strengthen long-term architectural capability.
    You will collaborate with relevant stakeholders to support decision-making and long-term development within the domain.

Requirements

    You have extensive experience working as a Senior IT Architect.
    You have experience within Data Analytics architecture.
    You have strong knowledge of information modelling and data modelling.
    You have a strong understanding of integration architecture and integration design.
    You have experience designing information models, data models, and integration architectures.
    You have experience documenting architecture, target states, and system landscapes.
    You have a good understanding of governance processes and architectural principles.
    You have experience providing architecture advisory services to senior stakeholders.
    You have experience mentoring, coaching, and developing internal team members.
    You can communicate and document complex architectural concepts in a structured manner.
    You are comfortable working across both strategic and operational levels.

Nice to have

    Experience within large-scale Data & Analytics environments.
    Experience with AI agents and agentic systems.
    Experience in enterprise-scale architecture environments.
    A relevant academic degree or equivalent professional experience.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Technical Inside sales - Heat exchangers
description:
Alfa Laval in Kolding, Søborg or Lund is looking for

Technical Inside Sales - Heat exchangers

Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  


As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

About the job

We are expanding our team and are looking for an outgoing and proactive Technical Inside Sales.

Working closely with external sales colleagues and product specialists, you will help drive profitable growth while building strong customer relationships. You will have the opportunity to develop deep product knowledge and contribute to the continued success of Alfa Laval's innovative solutions within Food and Pharma.



As a Technical Inside Sales, you will play a key role in supporting our customers and sales organization in the Nordics, by providing technical knowledge combined with quoting. You will have a focus on our heat exchangers; however, we also work with products like pumps and valves.

Your primary focus will be:



    Working in our CRM preparing quotations and handling price inquiries
    Handling customer inquiries - both on email and phone
    Provide technical datasheets and drawings

    Manage the shared inbox

    Upselling to customers/spotting potential business (involving KAM etc.)

    Identifying the best technical solutions and ensuring professional and timely customer experience.

You will be part of a team of ten and report to Tina Masini Tarp, a manager who aims to create a collaborative environment where people feel trusted, take ownership, and contribute to shared success. We offer you a dynamic role in which you can grow to be an expert but also where the development possibilities are plenty, not least within the area of sales.



Who are you

You are a customer-focused and proactive team player who enjoys combining technical knowledge with quoting. You take ownership of your tasks, work in a through structured manner, and thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can change.

You are a natural relationship builder and communicate confidently with both customers and colleagues. Most importantly, you are motivated by helping customers find the right solutions and creating value through excellent service.
You navigate easily in a larger organization and are not afraid to make contact with new people.



What you know

You will focus on a product group whose components can be assembled in almost endless variations. To succeed, we believe you have a genuine technical curiosity and ability to understand customer processes and applications. You enjoy working independently while collaborating effectively across functions.



Requirement:



    Experience from technical and/or inside sales or application engineering.
    Technical education preferably within the field of Process Technology, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field.
    Experience with CRM and ERP systems

    Excellent communication skills in English in addition to a Scandinavian language.



Merit:

    Knowledge of heat exchangers and/or experience from similar products and branches.



For more information, please contact

Tina Masini Tarp, Market Area Manager, Food & Pharma at or Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner

For union information, please contact:
Johan Ranhög, Akademikerna,
Monica Anderberg, Unionen,
Stefan Sandell, Ledarna,

We are conducting a continuous review of received applications.
We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Please send your application no later than October 4th, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!

At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in or have an established presence in the area of Kolding or Søborg (Denmark) or Lund (Sweden).

Our commitment to integrity

title: Transport and Handling Specialist - Switzerland
description:
What you'll do:
The Engineering Department (EN) provides CERN with the Engineering expertise, Infrastructure Systems and Technical Coordination necessary for the design, installation, operation, maintenance and dismantling phases of the CERN accelerator complex and its experimental facilities.

The position is within the Transport and Handling Engineering Group (EN-THE), responsible for preparing, organizing and coordinating all transport and handling operations for the CERN accelerators and experiments. The Group also manages the transport of thousands of conventional and unconventional items, chemical and radioactive products each year. As a Transport and Handling Specialist in EN-THE, you will be part of the Heavy Handling (EN-HE-HH) Section, which is in charge for organising and supervising transport, handling and lifting operations at CERNs accelerators complex, experimental areas and industrial buildings both underground and in surface premises.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinating transport and handling operations for the Accelerator complex, Experiments, and surface premises.
- Coordinating and planning meetings to evaluate technical and resource needs.
- Assessing and proposing possible handling and transport solutions.
- Defining technical and safety requirements for the transport of dangerous goods and ensuring compliance with ADR principles and applicable regulations.
- Specific operations by using customized equipment, analysing related working procedures and Safety assessments.
- Developing technical specifications, work procedures and contract documentation for transport and handling activities.
- Supervising contractor activities on site, ensuring Safety during the operations in both conventional and radioactive environments.
- Collaborating with the EN-THE design office to develop custom handling tools and conduct logistic studies.
- Collaborating with Radiation Protection Services to establish/redact the Work Dose Planning and Radiological work permit (DIMR).
- Performing handling operations in specific situations.

Your profile:
- Extensive experience in heavy handling and transport operations.
- Proven experience in worksite logistics.
- Proven experience in technical contract supervision.
- Proven experience of work in a radioactive environment will be an asset.
- Basic knowledge of remote-handling systems.
- A thorough understanding of the principles of ADR regulations in order to identify, interpret and communicate the requirements applicable to the transport of dangerous goods would be an asset.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Logistics, Mechanics or Electromechanics or a related field.
- ADR certificate would be an additional asset. Driving and operator licences for electrical overhead travelling cranes, industrial trucks, mobile elevating platforms, etc would be an additional asset.

Your skills:
- Operation and maintenance of lifting and handling equipment.
- Operation and maintenance of transport systems.
- Definition and installation of transport systems.
- Transport of dangerous goods.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Anticipates obstacles; assesses alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Follows rules and regulations and encourages others to do the same.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.
- Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60
Grade range: 4
Benchmark job: 301190 - Mechanical Technical Engineer
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/transport-and-handling-specialist/

title: ICT Support Specialist
description:
Systeme remote betreuen und ICT-Lösungen im Blick behalten – ohne Einsätze bei Kunden vor Ort.

Als spezialisiertes IT-Dienstleistungsunternehmen hat sich die Neo One AG zum persönlichen Partner für moderne ICT-Lösungen etabliert – vom KMU für KMU. Von den Standorten Bassersdorf wie auch Sursee aus unterstützen sie Kund:innen in rund 18 Kantonen mit einem umfassenden Portfolio – von Clients über Netzwerke und Server bis hin zu Compliance- und Datenschutzlösungen. Was die Neo One AG von anderen Anbietern unterscheidet? Sie setzen auf neue, frische und unkonventionelle Ansätze, um ICT-Lösungen auf innovative Weise neu zu denken. Im Zuge des weiteren Teamausbaus sind wir beauftragt, Sie als

ICT Support Specialist

anzusprechen. In dieser Funktion unterstützen Sie am Standort Bassersdorf massgeblich via Remote-Support die ICT-Infrastrukturen und Netzwerke der Kunden und stellen den Betrieb von On-Premises-, Cloud- sowie hybriden Umgebungen sicher. Sie bearbeiten Supportfälle und Kundenanliegen von 1st bis 3rd Level, überwachen proaktiv die Systemperformance und führen Fehleranalysen durch. Dabei stehen Sie in regelmässigem Austausch mit Ihren Teamkollegen und verantwortlichen Ansprechpersonen auf Kundenseite. Mit Ihrer Fachkompetenz, Zuverlässigkeit und schnellen Reaktionsfähigkeit gewährleisten Sie eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit im Remote-Betrieb und begleiten Change-Management-Prozesse professionell.

Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Informatik-Ausbildung (EFZ) und bringen mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Systemtechnik und im ICT-Support, vorzugsweise in einem IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit. Fundierte Kenntnisse von Microsoft Produkten sowie Client-, Netzwerk- und Serverlösungen (On-Premises und Cloud), ergänzt durch breites Wissen in Virtualisierung, Cyber Security und Storage zeichnen Sie aus. Sie arbeiten selbständig, strukturiert und kundenorientiert, überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke und sehr guten Deutsch- sowie Schweizerdeutschkenntnissen. Es erwartet Sie ein wachsendes, modernes Unternehmen, geprägt von Offenheit, flachen Hierarchien und attraktiven Benefits:

- Moderne Büroräumlichkeiten mit Einzelbüros

- Überobligatorische Sozialleistungen

- Kostenloser Tiefgaragen-Parkplatz direkt am Standort

- Besondere Teamevents und spontane «Team-Lunch-Aktionen»

- Attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bis hin zu Leitungsfunktion

- Teamkultur wie in einer Familie: Sie unterstützen sich gegenseiti

title: Gemeindeschreiber:in
description:
Verantwortung übernehmen, Wirkung entfalten – für eine moderne und dienstleistungsorientierte Gemeinde.

Unsere Auftraggeberin - die Gemeinde St. Moritz - gestaltet die nachhaltige Entwicklung des Ortes, schafft verlässliche Rahmenbedingungen und erbringt vielfältige Dienstleistungen für Bevölkerung, Wirtschaft, Politik und weitere Anspruchsgruppen. Die Gemeindeverwaltung nimmt dabei eine zentrale Rolle ein und bewegt sich in einem anspruchsvollen und dynamischen Umfeld. Im Zuge einer Nachfolgeregelung sind wir beauftragt, Sie als fachlich sowie menschlich überzeugende

Leiter:in Kanzlei / Gemeindeschreiber:in

anzusprechen. Direkt dem Gemeindepräsidenten unterstellt, führen Sie die Gemeindekanzlei mit den Bereichen Kanzleidienste, Einwohnerdienste, Soziales, Bibliotheken sowie Rechtsdienst mit insgesamt 18 Mitarbeitenden. Sie planen und begleiten die Geschäfte des Gemeindevorstands, des Gemeinderats und der Gemeindeversammlung. Dazu gehören die Vor- und Nachbereitung der Sitzungen, die Protokollführung sowie die redaktionelle Bearbeitung von Botschaften, Anträgen und Beschlüssen. Gemeinsam mit dem Rechtsdienst stellen Sie die rechtssichere Bearbeitung der Geschäfte sicher. Weiter verantworten Sie Wahlen und Abstimmungen, amtliche Publikationen, das Gemeindearchiv sowie verschiedene Bewilligungs- und Dienstleistungsprozesse. Sie entwickeln die Kanzlei weiter, optimieren Abläufe, treiben die Digitalisierung voran und wirken in abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten mit.

Für diese vielseitige Aufgabe verfügen Sie über eine fundierte Aus- und Weiterbildung im Bereich öffentliche Verwaltung, Gemeindeschreiberwesen, Public Management, Recht oder Betriebswirtschaft. Sie bringen mehrjährige Führungserfahrung innerhalb einer Gemeindeverwaltung, einer Gemeindekanzlei, eines Präsidialbereichs, eines Rechtsdienstes oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion mit. Ein gutes Verständnis für Verwaltungs- und Gemeinderecht, Sicherheit im Umgang mit politischen Behörden und stilsicheres Deutsch setzen wir voraus.

Sind Sie bereit, Ihren beruflichen und persönlichen Lebensmittelpunkt ins Engadin zu verlegen oder St. Moritz als neuen Arbeitsort zu entdecken? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Drone Assembly Operator
=======================

Fotokite develops autonomous, high\-endurance tethered unmanned aerial systems to help firefighters and public safety teams save lives.

Fotokite systems allow first responders to quickly and easily gain situational awareness after arriving at emergency scenes: our autonomous one\-touch launch/land system makes operation simple and safe; the dual color and thermal camera payload provides situational awareness from the system’s aerial perspective; and actively tethered flight means the system can be flown without a certified pilot, and can be left flying for as long as the situation requires.

The Drone Assembly Operator will work with a team of engineers and other technicians to build the organization’s newest products. This position performs hands\-on assembly of electro\-mechanical sub\-systems and provides input to the engineering team to assist them with developing and refining the manufacturing process of these products for low\-volume, in\-house production and eventual hand\-off to the commercial production line.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assemble complex electro\-mechanical sub\-systems, including testing, troubleshooting, and repair.
* Build products following work instructions and drawings with precision and consistency.
* Troubleshoots issues and communicates them to other technicians and/or the engineering team
* Provides feedback and observations related to the assembly process in the form of red\-lined drawings and written communication
* Maintains an organized workflow and workstation
* Receives and inspects components
* Conducts indoor assembly tests according to established procedures
* Monitors and reports on all aspects that relate to the quality of components and assemblies
* Tracks component inventory as it relates to build schedules
* Performs other duties as assigned


**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS**

* High School Diploma or equivalent and 2\+ years of related experience are required
* Ability to assemble complex electro\-mechanical systems using engineering assembly drawings
* Demonstrated keen eye for detail, a technical aptitude, and a desire to learn
* Experience handling ESD\-sensitive components, as well as working in an ESD\-safe environment following ESD\-safety best practices preferred
* Proven record of proactively working to meet production timelines
* Working experience with common spreadsheet and word processing tools, such as G\-Suite and/or MS Office
* Experience working for an international company is a plus
* Fluency in English and German is required, any other language is a plus

title: Biospecimen Specialist
description:
**Biospecimen Specialist \- biological specimens /** **sample acquisition / data management / biobanking / infectious material /****HRA, GDPR / LIMS / English / German**

**Project:** For our client based in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a Biospecimen Specialist (m/f/d).

**Background:**

You would be joining the Biospecimen Acquisition and Management (BAM) team in Rotkreuz. BAM is a service organization that has four teams situated across Europe and North America and that uses global capabilities with local support structures to drive integrated biological specimen solutions that accelerate Roche Diagnostics strategy.

The Biospecimen Specialist is responsible for the management of biospecimens and all associated sample/test data in compliance with local regulatory requirements, quality, business, and industry best practices/standards. Specifically, this role is dedicated to managing and running the BAM Team's Employee Specimen Donation Program (ESDP).

The perfect candidate is a highly motivated, organized, and accountable team player with a meticulous attention to detail. For this specific role, we are looking for a highly autonomous individual to successfully lead our internal collections and drive engagement through advertising campaigns. We are also looking for someone who is committed to ensuring the highest quality, accuracy, and timeliness of biospecimen deliverables.

**The Perfect Candidate:**

The ideal candidate holds a Life Sciences degree alongside hands\-on experience in biological specimen handling, biobanking, and validated systems like LIMS. They possess a solid understanding of ethics and compliance\-including informed consent, IRB protocols, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR\-to ensure full regulatory integrity across sample acquisition. End\-to\-end operational capability is key, as they will autonomously lead the internal Employee Specimen Donation Program, assemble collection kits, and perform precise biorepository data management. Highly organized and collaborative, this solution\-driven professional balances meticulous biospecimen traceability with strong English communication skills to align diverse stakeholders and meet project timelines.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

Employee Specimen Donation Program Coordination

* Autonomously lead and execute the Employee Specimen Donation Program to ensure reliable and compliant sample sourcing.
* Design and provide a strong advertisement campaign to effectively promote the donation program to internal employees.


Biorepository

* Manage and perform biological material processing, registration, shipment, returns, verification activities, retrievals, and inventory searches in a validated environment. Create sample collection kits.
* Take accountability for end\-to\-end project management and biorepository management activities to fulfill customer specimen requests.
* Collaborate with relevant permitting agencies, import/export compliance, and local Safety and Biorepository Teams to comply with permit requirements.


Data

* Conduct data management activities, including data review, import, quality and consistency checks, data searches, resolution of discrepancies, and data export while working within a validated LIMS.
* Assume accountability for data entry into validated database(s), ensuring information is entered accurately, consistently, and according to established formats.
* Maintain sample collection and/or study information according to applicable processes and procedures.


Others

* Effectively interface with internal and external stakeholders to establish timelines and meet defined project goals.
* Documentation \& Regulatory Maintenance: Ensure continuous process compliance, including the accurate collection and maintenance of all required legal, regulatory, and ethics documentation according to established BAM procedures.


**Must Haves:**

* Life science Bachelor's degree or equivalent, 1\-3 years relevant experience in sample acquisition, data management, biobanking.
* OR
* Life science Master's degree or equivalent, some experience in sample management, biobanking or related area.
* Experience in Handling biological specimens; willingness to work with potentially infectious biological material
* Knowledge of Ethics and Compliance: understanding of informed consent, IRB (Institutional Review Board) protocols, and data privacy regulations ( , HRA, GDPR) regarding human specimens
* IT skills: Microsoft office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Google Suite, Experience with LIMS or other validated systems
* English (min. B2\)
* Hepatitis vaccination available
* Able to lift 10 kg \- 15 kg

- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Männedorf suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Psychiatrie.

### Ihre Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Männedorf auf einen Blick

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Psychiatrie

**Pensum:** 60–80 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Männedorf

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Männedorf liegt idyllisch am Zürichsee und bietet Ihnen als Arbeitsort eine perfekte Balance zwischen Natur und Infrastruktur. Die ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit S-Bahn-Verbindungen ins Zürichland und zur Stadt Zürich ermöglicht Ihnen ein komfortables Pendeln. Die Region besticht durch ihre hohe Lebensqualität, das angenehme Seeklima und zahlreiche Freizeit- sowie Erholungsmöglichkeiten, die Sie nach der Arbeit geniessen können.

### Ihre Aufgaben als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie in Männedorf

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Diese Qualifikationen bringen Sie mit

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Psychiatrie

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie in Männedorf verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen mit Spezialisierung Psychiatrie ist in der Region Männedorf außergewöhnlich hoch. Sie profitieren von exzellenten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, da Fachkräfte vieler Arbeitgeber dringend benötigt werden. Als erfahrener Personalvermittler kennt iPersonal die regionalen Anforderungen und verbindet Sie gezielt mit passenden Stellen, was Ihnen Zeit spart und die Erfolgschancen deutlich erhöht.

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie in Männedorf

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**

L’Association s’est donnée pour mission d’accueillir, encadrer et accompagner des jeunes dans leurs difficultés, pour qu’ils gagnent en autonomie. Ses interventions se déroulent majoritairement dans les prestations résidentielles et, ponctuellement, dans les prestations ambulatoires.

La nature du poste nécessite une réelle capacité à intégrer rapidement des environnements de travail différents, à comprendre le fonctionnement d’une équipe et d’une prestation, et à trouver sa place dans des contextes variés. \- Vous appréciez la diversité des contextes de travail et êtes à l’aise avec un poste qui ne s’inscrit pas dans une seule équipe ou une seule structure.

\- Assurer des remplacements au sein des différentes prestations de l’Association, principalement résidentielles, afin de garantir la continuité de l’accompagnement éducatif.

Sie profitieren als Fachkraft von hervorragenden Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können in verschiedenen Institutionen wie Pflegeheimen und Spitälern tätig werden. iPersonal als erfahrener Vermittler kennt die regionalen Arbeitgeber und Anforderungen genau und erleichtert Ihnen durch persönliche Beratung, zielgerichtete Stellenvorschläge und umfassende Unterstützung den Einstieg in eine passende Position mit 80-100% Pensum erheblich.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Küsnacht

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Demenzbetreuung in Küsnacht

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

La Fédération des Producteurs Suisses de Lait (PSL) est l’organisation faîtière nationale des productrices et producteurs de lait suisses. Sous la marque Swissmilk, elle assure le marketing national en faveur du lait et des produits laitiers suisses. **Responsable Marketing / membre de la Direction**

Dans cette fonction clé, vous dirigez et développez l’ensemble du domaine Marketing de Swissmilk. En collaboration avec votre équipe de responsables expérimentés et quelque 50 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, vous veillez à un positionnement fort du lait et des produits laitiers suisses et développez systématiquement les activités marketing existantes. ### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Biel/Bienne

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Biel/Bienne liegt im Nordwesten des Kantons Bern und ist durch seine zentrale Lage zwischen Zürich und Genf sehr gut erreichbar. Die Stadt verfügt über einen modernen Bahnhof mit direkten Verbindungen zu allen Schweizer Metropolen. Als traditionsreiches Industriezentrum mit innovativen Unternehmen bietet die Region Ihnen attraktive Arbeitsplätze in der Uhrenindustrie, Technologie und dem Handwerk, kombiniert mit guter Lebensqualität und moderatem Mietniveau.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Biel/Bienne

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Biel/Bienne verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen im Langzeitbereich der Region Biel/Bienne ist anhaltend hoch, da die alternde Bevölkerung kontinuierlich mehr Betreuungskapazitäten benötigt. Sie profitieren als qualifizierte Fachkraft von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können in zahlreichen Institutionen wählerisch vorgehen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als spezialisierter Vermittler durch fundierte Kenntnisse des lokalen Marktes, individuelle Beratung und schnelle Platzierung in geeigneten Positionen, um Ihnen den beruflichen Einstieg oder Wechsel erheblich zu erleichtern.

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag

## Dipl. Expertin / Experte für Notfallpflege NDS 80-100% in Reute gesucht – Dein Fachwissen rettet Leben

Einsatzort: Reute und UmgebungEinsatzbeginn: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.
Wir suchen Unterstützung im Bereich Notfallpflege NDS Reute.

Reute liegt im Kanton Appenzell Ausserrhoden in der Ostschweiz und besticht durch seine ländliche, idyllische Lage inmitten der Appenzeller Hügellandschaft. Die Region ist gut mit dem öffentlichen Verkehr erreichbar und bietet Sie Ihnen eine hervorragende Work-Life-Balance durch die Nähe zu Natur und Kultur. Reute ist für Arbeitnehmende attraktiv, da es traditionelles Handwerk mit moderner Wirtschaft verbindet und gleichzeitig die hohe Lebensqualität der Ostschweiz garantiert.

Du suchst neue Jobs in der Notfallpflege in Reute, und gleichzeitig willst du in einem Umfeld arbeiten, in dem jede Entscheidung zählt? In dieser Rolle arbeitest du direkt mit Patienten, sodass schnelle Hilfe möglich ist und Leben geschützt werden. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du im Team, damit Abläufe klar bleiben und gut funktionieren.

Im Alltag erlebst du viele verschiedene Situationen, und dadurch bleibt deine Arbeit spannend, während du gleichzeitig Verantwortung übernimmst. Dein Wissen hilft dir, sodass du schnell reagieren kannst, und gleichzeitig bleibst du ruhig, damit du sicher handeln kannst.

Unser Temporärbüro Pflege Reute hilft dir dabei, passende offene Stellen für Pflege in Reute zu finden, sodass du flexibel arbeiten kannst und gleichzeitig eine stabile Lösung bekommst.

Mehr Informationen findest du hier:[https://www.med-ipersonal.ch](https://www.med-ipersonal.ch)

### Deine Aufgaben im Notfallalltag

Im Einsatz arbeitest du mit Patienten, und gleichzeitig triffst du schnelle Entscheidungen, sodass jede Situation gut gemeistert wird.

Du nimmst Patienten auf, und du beurteilst die Lage, damit klar ist, was zuerst gemacht werden muss. Danach handelst du sofort, sodass die Versorgung schnell beginnt und keine Zeit verloren geht.

Während der Behandlung überwachst du Patienten, sodass du Veränderungen sofort erkennst und reagieren kannst. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit Ärzten und Fachpersonen zusammen, damit alles gut abgestimmt ist und sicher bleibt.

title: Macro Commodities Options Strategist
description:
Overview
Balyasny Asset Management (BAM) is seeking a highly sophisticated, buy-side-proven Options Strategist to join a macro portfolio management team based in Switzerland.

Responsibilities
Trade Execution: Partner directly with the Portfolio Manager to translate high-conviction macro, commodity, and equity views into highly efficient options and derivatives structures. Experience executing sector baskets & determining optimal trade structures (e.g., spreads, outrights) to maximize capital efficiency and convexity.
Greeks Optimization: Systematically monitor and manage the portfolio's options-specific risks, with a rigorous focus on theta bleed/decay, volatility surface dynamics, and trade timing.
Downside & Tail-Hedging: Design, implement, and run robust tail-hedging and downside-protection frameworks. Ensure the portfolio is structurally insulated against tail risk, correlation breakdowns, and extreme market shocks.
Portfolio Construction: Proactively identify and monitor "blind spots" within the book, including hidden factor exposures, correlation breakdowns under stress, and liquidity gaps across various market regimes.
Drawdown Management: Formulate and manage drawdown mitigation processes, ensuring the net directionality of the book is dynamically adjusted and protected during periods of heightened volatility or performance drawdowns.
Cross-Asset Market Trade Idea Generation: Help generated high quality, high conviction trade ideas across sectors and asset classes; Equities, Commodities, and FX to identify relative-value & directional opportunities.

Requirements
Options & Volatility Expertise: An exceptional understanding of option pricing, volatility dynamics, and derivatives structures. While cross-asset options experience is highly preferred (specifically straddling Equities, Commodities, and Precious Metals), we are open to specialists from any asset class who demonstrate world-class derivatives expertise.
Seasoned Buy-Side Experience: The ideal candidate must possess significant, battle-tested hedge fund or proprietary trading firm experience. You must have lived through multiple market cycles, navigated severe drawdowns, and structurally managed risk in real-world, high-stress environments.
Portfolio Construction & Risk Analytics: Strong quantitative capabilities with the ability to model complex, multi-asset portfolios, identify liquidity gaps, and stress-test assets during correlation breakdown periods.
PM Collaboration: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. You must be able to challenge assumptions, present complex risk trade-offs to the Portfolio Manager, and work hand-in-hand to optimize the book's risk-reward profile.
Education: A degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline; or advanced degree a plus
Location: Ideally based in, or willing to relocate to Zug or Geneva, Switzerland.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation, inclusive of performance-based bonuses.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Pathways for professional growth and career development.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.
Opportunity to be part of building a great business where your efforts are recognized and valued.

**Technician – Quality Control Microbiology Laboratory**

As a Technician in the QC Microbiology Laboratory, you support day\-to\-day lab operations and ensure compliant sample handling and microbiology activities in a GMP\-regulated environment. * Perform non\-product testing as required ( , raw material visual inspection, environmental monitoring sampling, utility monitoring).
* Perform data review for assigned laboratory activities and ensure right\-first\-time documentation.

* Support deviation and laboratory investigations through data gathering and participation in interviews as needed.
* Support and/or draft updates to laboratory documents (SOPs, work instructions) for managerial review and approval.
* Record and monitor performance metrics; contribute to lab planning and scheduling inputs.
* Train and mentor colleagues on task execution and general job duties.
* Contribute to and lead simple projects; support complex projects within the team.

**Your profile**



* Strong experience with Environmental Monitoring (EM) sampling is required.
* Experience in a GMP\-regulated laboratory environment; ability to interpret and apply cGMP, USP, regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail, organization skills, and critical thinking.
* Good working knowledge of electronic systems (MS Office/email) and lab data systems ( , LIMS).

* High school diploma/GED with ≥3 years relevant experience, or

Trade Finance Officer (m/f/d)
=============================

**Quick Details**

**Location:** Geneva, Switzerland (100% On\-Site / Monday to Friday)

**Experience:** 5\+ Years in Trade Finance / Office Operations

**Start Date:**

**Key Software:** MS Excel, Word

**Languages:** English \& French (Fluent)

**Legal Requirement:** Valid Swiss Work Permit or Swiss/EU/EFTA Citizenship required

**Position Overview**

We are an established commercial business in Geneva seeking an autonomous, trustworthy Trade Finance Officer. This is a 100% in\-office role managing trade finance portfolios, contract flows, and day\-to\-day corporate communications.

The position requires a high level of confidentiality, accuracy, reliability and personal responsibility, with the ability to work independently, prioritize multiple tasks and coordinate effectively with banks, counterparties, suppliers, buyers and internal stakeholders.

Trade Finance \& BankingManage day\-to\-day communication and correspondence with banks, suppliers, buyers and other commercial , check and coordinate Letter of Credit (LC) drafts, including comments, amendments and negotiations with relevant parties.Prepare, submit, deliver and follow up on Cash Against Documents (CAD) documentation and related banking processes.Monitor trade finance transactions and ensure that required documentation is complete, accurate and submitted within the relevant deadlines.Contracts \& Commercial DocumentationPrepare and coordinate sales contracts, ensuring that commercial terms and agreed transaction details are accurately reflected.Maintain and organise transaction\-related documentation and correspondence.Coordinating documents flow between internal stakeholders, banks, suppliers, buyers and other Administration \& Record KeepingMaintain accurate and well\-organised physical and electronic filing systems for trade, banking, contractual and corporate documents are properly archived and readily accessible when up on outstanding documentation, signatures, approvals and other administrative matters.Accounting SupportCollect, organise and provide accurate transaction and financial data for accounting purposes.Prepare and maintain supporting information and accounting tables in coordination with the relevant accounting function.

5\+ years of proven experience bridging trade finance operations and office management within track record executing and managing Letter of Credit (L/C) and Cash Against Documents (CAD) commitment to a full\-time, structured, on\-site office rhythm (Monday to Friday, no hybrid option).Excellent command of English (for commercial contracts and deals) and French (for local administration and vendors).
