title: AML Manager
description:
**Job Description**  


**LGT Group**, a private wealth management group owned by the Princely House of Liechtenstein, is present in more than 20 locations throughout Europe, Asia, America and the Middle East, employing approximately 3,000 people.

**LGT Fund Managers (Ireland) Limited** provides fund administration services to mainly private equity funds and currently employs over 50 people.

The Company is seeking to appoint a highly motivated, Dublin\-based AML Manager with responsibility for operational delivery, stakeholder management, change ownership and team management. The AML Manager will oversee the daily operational deliverables of the Dublin AML team and work closely with their peer in our Luxembourg office to ensure alignment and consistent quality of service. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a growing team of 10 employees, reporting directly to the local Head of Unit. The role is critical to ensuring the effective delivery of AML operational activities, including investor onboarding, periodic reviews, screening, transaction monitoring and associated financial crime controls across the business.

Induction training will be provided, in addition to compulsory AML/KYC training and optional development opportunities. Additional role\-specific training will be delivered in\-house by peers, the line manager and senior management.

**Job specification**:

* **Operational Delivery**: Ensure strong control environment across investor onboarding, periodic reviews, screening, transaction monitoring and other tasks. Act as check for all relevant tasks;

* **Leadership \& Team Development**: Manage and coach direct reports, build the leadership pipeline, and implement structured training and knowledge\-sharing initiatives. Oversee performance reviews and manage team capacity, resource allocation and succession planning to support delivery of operational and strategic objectives.;

* **Client \& Stakeholder Management**: Act as a senior escalation point for team matters, maintain service levels and client satisfaction, and partner with stakeholders on roadmap initiatives;

* **Audits \& Inspections**: Support ad hoc and planned reviews by regulators, internal audit, compliance testing, ISAE 3402 and other assurance activities.

* **Process Improvement**: Identify and deliver improvements with regard to workflow design, technology and automation;

* **Risk Management and Ownership**: Manage and control risks within the AML unit. Contribute to updates for AML procedures, checklists and process documents;

* **Education**: Stay up to date with AML regulations, industry developments and best practices;

* **Governance**: Prepare and present management information where required.

**Requirements**

* Business\-related third\-level qualification;

* 8\-10 years' experience in fund administration, investor onboarding and financial crime compliance;

* Experience leading AML teams, managing complex escalations and cases;

* Completed professional qualification, such as LCI, CAMS, Professional Certificate in Financial Crime Prevention, Professional Certificate in Digital Risk, AML and Financial Crime Prevention, or equivalent;

* Proven experience leading teams of 5 or more people;

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills;

* Central Bank of Ireland inspection and/or audit experience preferred but not necessary;

* Client\-facing experience;

* Change management experience.

**Benefits**:

* **Hybrid Working Arrangement**: Following successful completion of the probation period, you will work three days per week in the office with colleagues and have the option to work two days per week from home;

* **Generous Employees Benefits Package**: performance related bonus plan, pension plan, life assurance, long term illness benefit, on\-site gym, subsidised lunches;

* **Professional Development**: Your professional and personal development is important to us. We offer internal and external training aligned with business needs, with opportunities to further develop German or English language skills where relevant;

* **Diverse Culture**: A culture of mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners, where you can make a meaningful impact;

* **Commitment to ESG**: Our long\-term perspective is shaped by the values of the Princely Family. Sustainability is central to how we act in business and in private life,and has been a key focus since 2002;

* We are proud to be owned by the Princely Family of Liechtenstein, and our successful company is strongly inspired by their entrepreneurial approach j4id10402157a j4it0939a j4iy26a

title: QA/QC Manager
description:
**Department:** **Quality Management**

**Reports to:** **Project Manager**

**Responsible for:** **Responsible for functional management of quality assurance within a global business unit. Establishes and maintains contacts with engineering, procurement, construction, project management, administrative services, test, operations, other organizations, client quality management and regulatory agencies as required to fulfill quality commitments. Staffs the responsible function with quality personnel and may be responsible for indoctrination and training of quality personnel.**

**Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**

**Start Date:**  

**Employment Type:** **Full time / On Site**

ENKA Investment AG is seeking a QA/QC Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead quality assurance activities across the building and its critical systems, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters in Istanbul.

***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***

* A recognized degree in an engineering or scientific discipline or equivalent, or specialized courses in engineering, quality, personnel administration or a specialized discipline
* Practical work experience as a project quality manager or in fields of engineering, procurement, construction, testing, operations, commissioning, or business administration
* Technical knowledge in the application of engineering, environmental, procurement, construction, testing, operations, and commissioning practices sufficient to comprehend specified engineering, environmental, procurement, construction, testing, operations, commissioning, and regulatory requirements.
* Professional fluency spoken and written Turkish, English are essential. Turkish is required for daily technical meetings and reporting with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters; (German is a plus for local coordination); English for the international project team and technical documentation.
* Knowledge of quality principles and their application to engineering, environmental, procurement, construction, testing, operations, and commissioning.
* Knowledge of the application of corrective actions to nonconforming conditions.
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements and functions which impact the quality program/plan.
* Knowledge of company policies and practices regarding personnel actions.
* Proficiency in oral and written communication; strong leadership and communication skills.
* Proficiency in providing direction and on the job training to assigned personnel.
* Proficiency in establishing and controlling budgets.


***Main Duties and Responsibilities***

* Directs the activities of quality supervisors and project quality managers
* Provides operational and technical direction to the quality personnel
* Maintains contacts with engineering, construction, procurement, administrative services, testing, operations, other organizations, project management, client quality, and regulatory agencies as delegated to implement corporate quality policies and procedures.
* Staffs projects with sufficient numbers of qualified quality personnel to meet quality program requirements.
* Develops and recommends procedures and instructions defining responsibilities and functions of quality personnel assigned to projects, to provide the required programs/plans with minimum schedule and cost impact on design, procurement, construction, testing, and operations.
* Reviews and provides comments and/or recommendations on project quality program/plan and project scope changes affecting quality, so that mandated quality levels can be met.
* Directs the implementation and administration of the quality assurance program/plan policies on projects to ensure achievement of quality goals.
* Prepares periodic reports for approval on the effectiveness of quality programs on the projects, and provides direction for resolving quality problems requiring special attention.
* Develops the quality staffing requirements, cost estimates, staffing forecasts, and budgets for projects.
* Establishes and directs quality assurance scope definition for projects and proposals within the quality assurance discipline.
* Conducts periodic staff meetings to monitor progress and status of quality assurance activities.
* Provide initial indoctrination and training to quality personal and ensures that training continues on project assignments through additional training sessions as required; monitors quality assurance effectiveness to assess the need for additional or refresher training programs.

title: Vice President Discovery
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

DISCO Pharmaceuticals is an emerging biotechnology company with operations in Cologne, Germany, and Schlieren, Switzerland. We leverage a proprietary mass spectrometry\-based technology platform to decode the molecular architecture of the cancer cell surface. By integrating expertise in cell biology, biochemistry, and computational analytics, we identify functionally relevant protein communities and novel therapeutic targets. Our mission is to develop innovative therapies for diseases with high unmet medical need, including cancer, and to translate new biological insights into meaningful clinical applications.

**POSITION**

We are seeking an experienced VP Discovery to provide leadership to the advancement of our innovative pipeline. This individual will play a critical role in driving portfolio execution and guiding multidisciplinary teams to deliver transformative therapies for patients with cancer. As a key member of the scientific leadership, you will oversee a team and the portfolio of multispecific and logic\-gated TCE/ADC programs from discovery to DC nomination, while partnering closely with senior leadership to shape portfolio strategy, governance, and resource allocation. The role is based in Schlieren, ZH, and involves occasional business travel.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Leading and driving DISCO’s discovery portfolio and scientific teams, with responsibility for portfolio execution, scientific strategy, prioritization, and delivery of key milestones across multispecific and logic\-gated TCE/ADC programs.

* Providing scientific and organizational leadership to multidisciplinary project teams, fostering a collaborative and high\-performing environment while supporting the development of future scientific leaders.

* Partnering closely with DISCO’s executive leadership team to shape and execute scientific and portfolio strategy, ensuring alignment between corporate goals, resource allocation, and program progression.

* Providing strategic guidance to Research Project Teams and Project Leads, supporting data\-driven decision making, milestone planning, risk management, and portfolio prioritization.

* Working closely with cross\-functional teams, including Antibody Engineering, Technology and CompBio, Translational Sciences, CMC, and Early Development functions, ensuring seamless advancement of programs across the organization.

* Communicating portfolio progress, opportunities, and risks to senior leadership, providing clear recommendations to support strategic decision\-making and portfolio management.

* Supporting business development and external innovation activities, including scientific due diligence, strategic collaborations, partnership opportunities, and evaluation of emerging technologies.

* Representing DISCO externally through scientific collaborations, conference participation, publications, and interactions with key opinion leaders and potential partners.

**YOUR PROFILE**

Qualification

You hold a PhD in Immunology, Oncology, Molecular Biology, or a related life science discipline. In addition, you bring more than 14 years of relevant experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical drug discovery and development, including senior scientific and organizational leadership responsibilities. You have a proven track record of advancing innovative oncology programs from discovery through development candidate nomination and possess deep expertise in multispecific biologics and T\-cell engager platforms. You are passionate about translating groundbreaking science into innovative therapies that address significant unmet medical needs.

**Experience**

We expect competencies in the following areas:

* Proven track record of leading multiple preclinical drug discovery programs, including target validation, lead identification, candidate optimization, and advancement to IND\-enabling activities.

* Extensive expertise in multispecific biologics and T\-cell engager platforms, ideally within immuno\-oncology and oncology\-focused therapeutic areas.

* Experience developing and executing translational and preclinical strategies, including proof\-of\-concept, mechanism\-of\-action, and biomarker studies.

* Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary teams and complex portfolios within matrix organizations across Discovery, Technology, and Early Development.

* Strong portfolio, project, and resource management capabilities, with the ability to prioritize and deliver across multiple programs simultaneously.

title: Event Manager (a) in Zürich 80-100%
description:
Du brennst für Events und liebst es, Menschen zusammenzubringen? Ob Kundenanlass, Fachkonferenz oder internes Teamevent – du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Event unvergesslich wird. Gleichzeitig fühlst du dich in der Marketingwelt zuhause und es motiviert dich, dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld rund um Business Software Lösungen zu bewegen.

**Das macht deinen Alltag spannend:**

* Du machst unsere Events zu echten Erlebnissen. Denn von der ersten Idee bis zum letzten Applaus hältst du die Fäden in der Hand und begeisterst Kunden, Partner und Kolleg\*innen gleichermassen.
* Mit frischen Event\-Konzepten setzt du unsere Softwarelösungen gekonnt in Szene und sorgst dafür, dass sie nicht nur verstanden, sondern erlebt werden.
* Du jonglierst souverän mit allen Beteiligten. Sei dies intern wie extern, von Location bis Technik, von Speaker bis Dienstleister.
* Ob Einladung, Landingpage, Mailings oder Aftermovie: Du bringst unsere Event\-Kommunikation auf den Punkt und gibst jedem Anlass die nötige Strahlkraft.
* Kleinere Events moderierst du selbstbewusst oder sorgst dafür, dass unsere Expert\*innen im perfekten Setup glänzen können.
* Mit deinem Blick fürs Ganze hältst du das Budget im Griff, misst den Erfolg und optimierst, wo es sinnvoll ist.
* Passende Werbeartikel und Give\-aways finden dank dir den Weg zu Kunden und Mitarbeitenden.
* Und weil Events nicht alles sind: Du entwickelst auch Marketing\- und Kampagnenideen, die unsere Anlässe pushen und unsere Leistungen sichtbar machen.
* Ins Marketingteam bringst du frischen Wind, kreative Inputs und jede Menge Teamspirit mit, damit wir gemeinsam unsere Events auf das nächste Level heben.


**Das bringst du mit:**

* Du hast eine Ausbildung im Marketing\-, Event\- oder Kommunikationsbereich oder bist auf einem anderen Weg dorthin gekommen und weisst genau, was du kannst.
* Erste Erfahrungen in der Eventorganisation und im Marketing hast du bereits gesammelt und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen IT\-Umfeld wohl.
* Events sind dein Ding! Du sprudelst vor Ideen, liebst kreative Lösungen und probierst gerne Neues aus.
* Du gehst deinen Alltag strukturiert und selbständig an und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung. Ruhe bewahrst du auch dann, wenn mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig laufen.
* Stilsicheres Deutsch ist für dich selbstverständlich, denn eine klare Kommunikation ist Gold wert.
* Deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen freuen sich auf Verstärkung von einer unkomplizierten Persönlichkeit, die gerne lacht, auch über sich selber.


**Und das hast du dann davon:**

* Ein Job, der garantiert nicht langweilig wird: Mit klarem Fokus auf Events gestaltest du richtig viel und bekommst den Freiraum, deine Ideen gross zu machen.
* Ein Team, das dich unterstützt und einen Teamspirit, der bei Kununu schon fünf Sterne bekommen hat.
* Von null auf hundert in 19… nein, nicht Sekunden, Jahren. Wir sind schnell, aber gesund gewachsen und gut organisiert. Doch etwas ist noch wie in unseren Anfängen: Die Strukturen sind schlank und du findest die richtigen Ansprechpartner leicht.
* Sobald du im Job angekommen bist, warten spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten auf dich.
* Einen guten Lohn, den du mit deiner Leistung mitbestimmen kannst. Krankentaggeld\- und Unfallversicherung? Übernehmen wir. Zusammen mit anderen Benefits macht das schnell noch einmal ein paar Tausender im Jahr aus.


Wir hätten noch viel mehr zu erzählen. Was deinen Job bei uns sonst noch spannend macht zum Beispiel. Wer wir sind und wie wir so ticken. Deshalb zögere nicht und macht dir dein eigenes Bild.

**Schon Feuer gefangen?**Du willst lieber schon heute als morgen loslegen? Dann her mit deinem CV oder dem Link auf dein LinkedIn\-Profil. Das Motivationsschreiben kannst du dir sparen, wir sind auch da völlig unkompliziert.

**Und das (a) im Stellentitel?**Es ist unser Statement für Vielfalt. Wir stehen auf durchmischte Teams. Alter, Herkunft, Hautfarbe oder Geschlecht sind uns egal. Bei uns sind **(a)**lle willkommen, die uns mit ihrem Talent weiterbringen.

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager - Electronics
description:
Strategic Sourcing Manager

Purpose of the role

  *  Developing and executing global sourcing strategies for the assigned direct materials categories (electronics)
  *  Acting as a business partner to key stakeholders in Business (Business Units, Engineering, etc.) and Operations (Product Line Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Production, Materials Management, etc.)
  *  Sustaining the Global Strategic Sourcing Operating Model and providing supply capability and capacity at best cost to support future business needs and protect brand value
  *  Applying aligned sourcing processes, sustainable supplier assessments, and development approaches to establish and actively manage a performing and regulatory-compliant supply base footprint
  *  Contributing to the enhancement of supply base performance on Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QCD)
  *  Realizing measurable value of >3% in recurring and P&L-effective cost reductions per year across the global third-party spend in the assigned categories through leveraged and benchmarked supply base management
  *  Growing and further developing a qualified and performing Best Cost Country (BCC) supply base in line with company and operations objectives, preferably in Eastern Europe, while managing a sustainable spend allocation


Responsibilities:

  *  Management of own material categories (capacity, knowledge management, performance)
  *  Accountable for contributing to global Direct Material & Supply Base Performance (QCD)
  *  Representing own direct material categories within the VAT organization
  *  Accountable for category-specific achievement of objectives related to cost optimization, supply base optimization, geographic sourcing footprint, and Best Cost Country Sourcing
  *  Providing forward-looking guidance on trends, threats, and opportunities within assigned categories (e.g., raw materials)
  *  Actively contributing to the bottom-up alignment of the Direct Materials Category Team with defined company objectives
  *  Acting as the interface to Business Units and Engineering for Strategic Sourcing activities along the PDP (IP07) process
  *  Acting as a change agent toward key stakeholders
  *  Developing category sourcing strategies using defined methods and tools
  *  Managing supplier relationships across the global supply base within assigned category scope, in alignment with category teams in Switzerland, Malaysia, and Romania
  *  Ensuring consistent application of all sourcing levers
  *  Contributing to key sourcing KPIs
  *  Assembling and actively leading category-specific and cross-functional sourcing boards
  *  Actively monitoring and conducting supply base risk assessments across assigned categories
  *  Participating in and contributing to the continuous improvement of direct material sourcing practices


Qualifications:  

  *  3-4 years of in-depth strategic and operational sourcing experience with solid knowledge of global category management
  *  Demonstrated experience with category-specific production techniques and processes
  *  Knowledge of category sourcing markets
  *  Proficiency in Office software and IT applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  *  Experience sourcing in Eastern Europe and Asia, including Best Cost Country sourcing and spend relocation activities
  *  Experience working within a global and complex organization
  *  Experience in machine building, vacuum technology, and semiconductors
  *  Experience in cross-functional and category team management (at least functional leadership)
  *  Strong interpersonal, sensitive, and empathetic communication skills with suppliers, colleagues, and internal stakeholders
  *  Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making skills with a focus on key facts
  *  Ability to achieve results through others, manage multiple priorities, set priorities effectively, and handle pressure
  *  Good communication skills in German and English; additional languages are a plus

title: Ergotherapeut (w/m/d)
description:
Ergotherapeut (w/m/d)

Unsere Kundin ist eine spezialisierte Rehabilitationsklinik mit nationalem Versorgungsauftrag. Die Klinik verfügt über mehrere hundert Betten und Mitarbeitende und ist auf die medizinische und berufliche Rehabilitation von Patienten nach Unfall oder Erkrankung ausgerichtet. Die Ergotherapie ist fester Bestandteil der interdisziplinären Behandlungskonzepte.

Begleiten Sie die Patienten zurück in ihre berufliche Selbstständigkeit. Jetzt bewerben und nachhaltig Wirkung erzielen.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben:

- Ergotherapeutische Begleitung im Rahmen der beruflichen Rehabilitation

- Einschätzung funktioneller und arbeitsbezogener Fähigkeiten

- Planung und Durchführung praxisnaher Trainingsprogramme

- Enge Abstimmung mit interdisziplinären Fachbereichen

Ihr Profil:

- Ausbildung / Studium Ergotherapie

- Interesse an beruflicher Rehabilitation

- Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Vorgehensweise

- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein im Patientenkontakt

Ihre Vorteile:

- Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit mit klarer therapeutischer Zielsetzung

- Eingebunden in ein erfahrenes interdisziplinäres Team

- Attraktive Vergütung im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen

- Leben in der Schweiz mit hoher Lebensqualität und naturnahem Umfeld

Das Team von SwissPromed coacht und begleitet Sie durch den kompletten Bewerbungs- und Anerkennungsprozess. Wir unterstützen Sie bei den Kosten für die SRK-Anerkennung. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir Sie bei der Relocation in die Schweiz und bei praktischen Fragen (Anmeldung, Bankkonto, Versicherung etc.).

Wir garantieren Ihnen absolute Diskretion.

Bei Fragen stehe ich Ihnen gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung!

SwissPromed ist Ihr zuverlässiger Partner, wenn es um die Vermittlung von medizinischem Fach- und Führungspersonal geht. Wir ermöglichen Ihnen den Zugang zum schweizerischen Stellenmarkt und unterstützen Sie mit wertvollem Hintergrundwissen bei der Planung und Realisierung Ihres nächsten Karriereschrittes. Mit unserem umfangreichen Leistungsangebot bereiten wir unsere Kandidaten optimal vor und begleiten sie auf Basis unserer Erfahrungswerte bestmöglich beim Umzug in die Schweiz.

Gestalten Sie den nächsten Schritt Ihrer beruflichen Laufbahn in einem modernen medizinischen Kompetenzzentrum, das Exzellenz, Innovation und Menschlichkeit vereint.

Im Zuge einer Nachfolgeregelung eines Arztkollegen, suchen wir im Auftrag unseres Mandanten, eines etablierten Kompetenzzentrums mit interdisziplinärer Ausrichtung, eine fachlich wie menschlich überzeugende Persönlichkeit, die ihre Expertise und Leidenschaft in einem anspruchsvollen, zukunftsorientierten und wertschätzenden Umfeld langfristig einbringen und dessen Weiterentwicklung aktiv mitprägen möchte.

Die interdisziplinäre Gruppenpraxis steht für höchste medizinische Qualität und bietet Ihnen ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit erstklassiger Infrastruktur, einem umfassenden Leistungsspektrum sowie einem stilvollen und architektonisch ansprechenden Ambiente.

Das medizinische Leistungsspektrum umfasst die Bereiche Hausarztmedizin, Gynäkologie sowie Chirurgie und ermöglicht durch die enge interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit eine qualitativ hochstehende und ganzheitliche Patientenversorgung.

Ein hohes Mass an fachlicher Autonomie sowie flexible und individuell gestaltbare Arbeitszeitmodelle bieten den ärztlichen Kolleginnen und Kollegen die Möglichkeit, ihre beruflichen und persönlichen Ziele in einem anspruchsvollen und wertschätzenden Umfeld nachhaltig zu verwirklichen.

**Hausärztin / Hausarzt FMH - Interdisziplinäres Kompetenzzentrum**

Ihr Verantwortungsbereich:
- Sie übernehmen die eigenverantwortliche ambulante Betreuung und medizinische Versorgung Ihrer Patientinnen und Patienten innerhalb des interdisziplinären Kompetenzzentrums. Es erwartet Sie ein vielseitiges Tätigkeitsfeld mit einem breiten diagnostischen und therapeutischen Spektrum der Allgemeinen Inneren Medizin. Gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Team aus ärztlichen Kolleginnen und Kollegen gestalten Sie eine Medizin, die höchste Qualitätsansprüche mit einer persönlichen und nachhaltigen Patientenbetreuung verbindet. Der Mensch steht dabei stets im Mittelpunkt Ihres Handelns. Eigeninitiative, unternehmerisches Denken und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Ihre Persönlichkeit:
- Sie verfügen über einen Facharzttitel in Allgemeiner Innerer Medizin FMH oder über eine gleichwertig anerkannte Qualifikation beziehungsweise sind Praktische Ärztin / Praktischer Arzt. Idealerweise bringen Sie bereits Erfahrung in der ambulanten Grundversorgung im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen mit. Die ganzheitliche Betreuung Ihrer Patientinnen und Patienten von der Prävention über die Diagnostik bis hin zur nachhaltigen Nachsorge, entspricht Ihrem beruflichen Selbstverständnis. Sie verbinden medizinische Fachkompetenz mit Empathie und pflegen einen wertschätzenden Umgang mit Ihren Patientinnen und Patienten. Sie schätzen eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, bringen Teamgeist mit und möchten die Weiterentwicklung einer modernen interdisziplinären Gruppenpraxis aktiv mitgestalten.

Ihre Perspektiven:
- Es erwartet Sie eine attraktive Position mit zeitgemässen Anstellungsbedingungen in einem stilvollem Praxisambiente und zukunftsorientierten medizinischen Kompetenzzentrum. Dank flexibler Arbeitszeitmodelle profitieren Sie von einer ausgezeichneten Work-Life-Balance und können Ihre beruflichen und privaten Ziele optimal miteinander verbinden.
Sie werden Teil eines engagierten und kollegialen Teams, das den fachlichen Austausch aktiv lebt und grossen Wert auf eine partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit legt.
Übernahme eines berstendes Patientenstamms, der Ihnen einen optimalen Einstieg in Ihre neue Tätigkeit ermöglicht.
Sie geniessen ein hohes Mass an fachlicher Autonomie und Gestaltungsfreiheit bei der Organisation Ihrer Sprechstunden. Eigene Ideen und unternehmerisches Mitdenken sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und finden in einem von erfahrenen ärztlichen Kolleginnen und Kollegen geprägten Umfeld den entsprechenden Raum zur Entfaltung.

Ergänzt wird dieses attraktive Angebot durch die zentrale Lage mit hervorragender Anbindung an den öffentlichen Fern- und Nahverkehr.

title: Transport and Handling Specialist - Switzerland
description:
What you'll do:
The Engineering Department (EN) provides CERN with the Engineering expertise, Infrastructure Systems and Technical Coordination necessary for the design, installation, operation, maintenance and dismantling phases of the CERN accelerator complex and its experimental facilities.

The position is within the Transport and Handling Engineering Group (EN-THE), responsible for preparing, organizing and coordinating all transport and handling operations for the CERN accelerators and experiments. The Group also manages the transport of thousands of conventional and unconventional items, chemical and radioactive products each year. As a Transport and Handling Specialist in EN-THE, you will be part of the Heavy Handling (EN-HE-HH) Section, which is in charge for organising and supervising transport, handling and lifting operations at CERNs accelerators complex, experimental areas and industrial buildings both underground and in surface premises.

title: Macro Commodities Options Strategist
description:
Overview
Balyasny Asset Management (BAM) is seeking a highly sophisticated, buy-side-proven Options Strategist to join a macro portfolio management team based in Switzerland.

Responsibilities
Trade Execution: Partner directly with the Portfolio Manager to translate high-conviction macro, commodity, and equity views into highly efficient options and derivatives structures. Experience executing sector baskets & determining optimal trade structures (e.g., spreads, outrights) to maximize capital efficiency and convexity.
Greeks Optimization: Systematically monitor and manage the portfolio's options-specific risks, with a rigorous focus on theta bleed/decay, volatility surface dynamics, and trade timing.
Downside & Tail-Hedging: Design, implement, and run robust tail-hedging and downside-protection frameworks. Ensure the portfolio is structurally insulated against tail risk, correlation breakdowns, and extreme market shocks.
Portfolio Construction: Proactively identify and monitor "blind spots" within the book, including hidden factor exposures, correlation breakdowns under stress, and liquidity gaps across various market regimes.
Drawdown Management: Formulate and manage drawdown mitigation processes, ensuring the net directionality of the book is dynamically adjusted and protected during periods of heightened volatility or performance drawdowns.
Cross-Asset Market Trade Idea Generation: Help generated high quality, high conviction trade ideas across sectors and asset classes; Equities, Commodities, and FX to identify relative-value & directional opportunities.

Requirements
Options & Volatility Expertise: An exceptional understanding of option pricing, volatility dynamics, and derivatives structures. While cross-asset options experience is highly preferred (specifically straddling Equities, Commodities, and Precious Metals), we are open to specialists from any asset class who demonstrate world-class derivatives expertise.
Seasoned Buy-Side Experience: The ideal candidate must possess significant, battle-tested hedge fund or proprietary trading firm experience. You must have lived through multiple market cycles, navigated severe drawdowns, and structurally managed risk in real-world, high-stress environments.
Portfolio Construction & Risk Analytics: Strong quantitative capabilities with the ability to model complex, multi-asset portfolios, identify liquidity gaps, and stress-test assets during correlation breakdown periods.
PM Collaboration: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. You must be able to challenge assumptions, present complex risk trade-offs to the Portfolio Manager, and work hand-in-hand to optimize the book's risk-reward profile.
Education: A degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline; or advanced degree a plus
Location: Ideally based in, or willing to relocate to Zug or Geneva, Switzerland.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation, inclusive of performance-based bonuses.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Pathways for professional growth and career development.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.
Opportunity to be part of building a great business where your efforts are recognized and valued.

title: Transport and Handling Specialist - Switzerland
description:
What you'll do:
The Engineering Department (EN) provides CERN with the Engineering expertise, Infrastructure Systems and Technical Coordination necessary for the design, installation, operation, maintenance and dismantling phases of the CERN accelerator complex and its experimental facilities.

The position is within the Transport and Handling Engineering Group (EN-THE), responsible for preparing, organizing and coordinating all transport and handling operations for the CERN accelerators and experiments. The Group also manages the transport of thousands of conventional and unconventional items, chemical and radioactive products each year. As a Transport and Handling Specialist in EN-THE, you will be part of the Heavy Handling (EN-HE-HH) Section, which is in charge for organising and supervising transport, handling and lifting operations at CERNs accelerators complex, experimental areas and industrial buildings both underground and in surface premises.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinating transport and handling operations for the Accelerator complex, Experiments, and surface premises.
- Coordinating and planning meetings to evaluate technical and resource needs.
- Assessing and proposing possible handling and transport solutions.
- Defining technical and safety requirements for the transport of dangerous goods and ensuring compliance with ADR principles and applicable regulations.
- Specific operations by using customized equipment, analysing related working procedures and Safety assessments.
- Developing technical specifications, work procedures and contract documentation for transport and handling activities.
- Supervising contractor activities on site, ensuring Safety during the operations in both conventional and radioactive environments.
- Collaborating with the EN-THE design office to develop custom handling tools and conduct logistic studies.
- Collaborating with Radiation Protection Services to establish/redact the Work Dose Planning and Radiological work permit (DIMR).
- Performing handling operations in specific situations.

Your profile:
- Extensive experience in heavy handling and transport operations.
- Proven experience in worksite logistics.
- Proven experience in technical contract supervision.
- Proven experience of work in a radioactive environment will be an asset.
- Basic knowledge of remote-handling systems.
- A thorough understanding of the principles of ADR regulations in order to identify, interpret and communicate the requirements applicable to the transport of dangerous goods would be an asset.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Logistics, Mechanics or Electromechanics or a related field.
- ADR certificate would be an additional asset. Driving and operator licences for electrical overhead travelling cranes, industrial trucks, mobile elevating platforms, etc would be an additional asset.

Your skills:
- Operation and maintenance of lifting and handling equipment.
- Operation and maintenance of transport systems.
- Definition and installation of transport systems.
- Transport of dangerous goods.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Anticipates obstacles; assesses alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Follows rules and regulations and encourages others to do the same.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.
- Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60
Grade range: 4
Benchmark job: 301190 - Mechanical Technical Engineer
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/transport-and-handling-specialist/

Drone Assembly Operator
=======================

Fotokite develops autonomous, high\-endurance tethered unmanned aerial systems to help firefighters and public safety teams save lives.

Fotokite systems allow first responders to quickly and easily gain situational awareness after arriving at emergency scenes: our autonomous one\-touch launch/land system makes operation simple and safe; the dual color and thermal camera payload provides situational awareness from the system’s aerial perspective; and actively tethered flight means the system can be flown without a certified pilot, and can be left flying for as long as the situation requires.

The Drone Assembly Operator will work with a team of engineers and other technicians to build the organization’s newest products. This position performs hands\-on assembly of electro\-mechanical sub\-systems and provides input to the engineering team to assist them with developing and refining the manufacturing process of these products for low\-volume, in\-house production and eventual hand\-off to the commercial production line.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assemble complex electro\-mechanical sub\-systems, including testing, troubleshooting, and repair.
* Build products following work instructions and drawings with precision and consistency.
* Troubleshoots issues and communicates them to other technicians and/or the engineering team
* Provides feedback and observations related to the assembly process in the form of red\-lined drawings and written communication
* Maintains an organized workflow and workstation
* Receives and inspects components
* Conducts indoor assembly tests according to established procedures
* Monitors and reports on all aspects that relate to the quality of components and assemblies
* Tracks component inventory as it relates to build schedules
* Performs other duties as assigned

* High School Diploma or equivalent and 2\+ years of related experience are required
* Ability to assemble complex electro\-mechanical systems using engineering assembly drawings
* Demonstrated keen eye for detail, a technical aptitude, and a desire to learn
* Experience handling ESD\-sensitive components, as well as working in an ESD\-safe environment following ESD\-safety best practices preferred
* Proven record of proactively working to meet production timelines
* Working experience with common spreadsheet and word processing tools, such as G\-Suite and/or MS Office
* Experience working for an international company is a plus
* Fluency in English and German is required, any other language is a plus

title: Biospecimen Specialist
description:
**Biospecimen Specialist \- biological specimens /** **sample acquisition / data management / biobanking / infectious material /****HRA, GDPR / LIMS / English / German**

**Project:** For our client based in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a Biospecimen Specialist (m/f/d).

**Background:**

You would be joining the Biospecimen Acquisition and Management (BAM) team in Rotkreuz. BAM is a service organization that has four teams situated across Europe and North America and that uses global capabilities with local support structures to drive integrated biological specimen solutions that accelerate Roche Diagnostics strategy.

The Biospecimen Specialist is responsible for the management of biospecimens and all associated sample/test data in compliance with local regulatory requirements, quality, business, and industry best practices/standards. Specifically, this role is dedicated to managing and running the BAM Team's Employee Specimen Donation Program (ESDP).

The perfect candidate is a highly motivated, organized, and accountable team player with a meticulous attention to detail. For this specific role, we are looking for a highly autonomous individual to successfully lead our internal collections and drive engagement through advertising campaigns. We are also looking for someone who is committed to ensuring the highest quality, accuracy, and timeliness of biospecimen deliverables.

**The Perfect Candidate:**

The ideal candidate holds a Life Sciences degree alongside hands\-on experience in biological specimen handling, biobanking, and validated systems like LIMS. They possess a solid understanding of ethics and compliance\-including informed consent, IRB protocols, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR\-to ensure full regulatory integrity across sample acquisition. End\-to\-end operational capability is key, as they will autonomously lead the internal Employee Specimen Donation Program, assemble collection kits, and perform precise biorepository data management. Highly organized and collaborative, this solution\-driven professional balances meticulous biospecimen traceability with strong English communication skills to align diverse stakeholders and meet project timelines.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

Employee Specimen Donation Program Coordination

* Autonomously lead and execute the Employee Specimen Donation Program to ensure reliable and compliant sample sourcing.
* Design and provide a strong advertisement campaign to effectively promote the donation program to internal employees.


Biorepository

* Manage and perform biological material processing, registration, shipment, returns, verification activities, retrievals, and inventory searches in a validated environment. Create sample collection kits.
* Take accountability for end\-to\-end project management and biorepository management activities to fulfill customer specimen requests.
* Collaborate with relevant permitting agencies, import/export compliance, and local Safety and Biorepository Teams to comply with permit requirements.


Data

* Conduct data management activities, including data review, import, quality and consistency checks, data searches, resolution of discrepancies, and data export while working within a validated LIMS.
* Assume accountability for data entry into validated database(s), ensuring information is entered accurately, consistently, and according to established formats.
* Maintain sample collection and/or study information according to applicable processes and procedures.


Others

* Effectively interface with internal and external stakeholders to establish timelines and meet defined project goals.

LeoVest Partners AG is a Swiss independent EAM and Multi\-Family Office headquartered in Zurich, with an office in Geneva. Today, we manage CHF 2 billion in assets and employ 29 professionals with more than 765 years of combined industry experience.

We offer two distinct investment philosophies. Our Active Investing approach is contrarian and value\-oriented, based on rigorous fundamental analysis and a disciplined building\-block framework with a long\-term investment horizon.

Our Passive Investing approach follows a systematic four\-factor model combining Growth, Value, Momentum and Size to provide diversified and cost\-efficient market exposure.

DevOps Engineer (a) (80 – 100%)
=================================




**HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.**

**Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.**




**Deine Herausforderung**

* Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.

* Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.

* Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.

* Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.

* Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.

* Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.

* Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.

* Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.




**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld

* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)

* Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab

* Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein

* Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.

* In Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher




**Möchtest du ein DevOps\-Team von Grund auf mitgestalten und deine Erfahrungen einbringen? Suchst du ein stabiles Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen gehört werden?**

Dann freut sich **Thomas Lüthi** auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder auf deinen Anruf.

title: F1 Embedded Application Software Engineer
description:
Join the FIA and play a key role in developing and monitoring the advanced technologies powering Formula 1.
As an Application Software Engineer within the FIA Technical Department, you will strengthen our in-house embedded software capabilities to implement, monitor, and enforce Formula 1 technical and sporting regulations. You will work on complex multi-system electronics projects requiring seamless integration across control units, sensors, communication networks, and data systems.
Based in Geneva, this new role requires working within a fast-paced, multidisciplinary team and includes trackside travel to Formula 1 events (approximately 12 events per year).

MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Embedded application software development
Design, implement, validate, and maintain robust in-house embedded software for key FIA Formula 1 platforms, notably the FIA Standard ECU and Accident Data Recorder, to monitor and enforce regulatory compliance.
Lead end-to-end multi-system integration across control units, sensors, vehicle communication buses, telemetry networks, and FIA data-analysis suites.
Translate complex sporting, technical, and operational requirements into high-integrity software architectures, detailed specifications, and rigorous verification plans.
Develop specialized simulation, test, and data-analysis tools to accelerate software validation, support regulatory evolution, and guarantee operational readiness.
Execute functional and integration testing on bench and vehicle environments in close collaboration with F1 teams, power unit manufacturers, and electronics suppliers.
Troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain application software repositories, applying rigorous code reviews, version control, and clear technical documentation to ensure long-term reliability and maintainability.
Build and scale in-house engineering capabilities, reinforcing the FIA’s operational independence and responsiveness to emerging technical demands.

Auditing of electronic systems
Inspect competitors' embedded software, system behaviour, and telemetry data for compliance across chassis and powertrain regulations.
Develop automated auditing tools and liaise with suppliers to streamline electronic inspection and homologation workflows.

Development strategy and regulatory support
Support future regulation updates through proactive simulation, system modeling, and technical validation.
Define specifications for future FIA electronic architectures, safeguard FIA intellectual property, and contribute technical input to F1 working groups.

Race and test support
Provide trackside support at F1 races and tests (~12 events/year) to configure, operate, and monitor FIA electronics and data-logging systems.
Analyse real-time vehicle telemetry to verify regulatory compliance and resolve cross-system software anomalies in collaboration with teams and manufacturers.

PROFILE:
Master’s degree in Electronics, Control Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 3 to 5 years of professional experience in embedded control systems or real-time application software development within a competitive motorsport environment (Formula 1, Formula E, WEC).
Knowledge of the FIA Formula 1 Standard ECU and its application software tool suite would be a significant advantage.
Proven track record in real-time embedded software development, testing, and lifecycle management; proficiency in MATLAB, Simulink, and Simscape.
Strong understanding of Formula 1 or Formula E or WEC chassis and powertrain operation, including associated electronic, electrical, communication, control and data systems.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex multi-system electronics projects involving the integration and validation of interconnected embedded systems.
Excellent organisational and communication skills, autonomy under pressure, and adaptability to high-tempo trackside environments.
Absolute discretion regarding confidential data; fluent written and spoken English.

If you are interested, please send your application in PDF format

The FIA is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates.

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager - Elastomers
description:
Strategic Sourcing Manager

Purpose of the role

  *  Developing and executing global sourcing strategies for the assigned direct materials categories (elastomers)
  *  Acting as a business partner to key stakeholders in business (Business Units, Engineering, etc.) and Operations (Product Line Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Production, Materials Management, etc.)
  *  The global category manager shall sustain the Global Strategic Sourcing Operating Model and provide the supply capability and capacity at best cost to support the company’s future business needs and protection of brand value
  *  Application of aligned sourcing processes, sustainable supplier assessments and development approach, a performing and regulatory compliant supply base footprint shall be established and actively managed, contributing to the enhancement of the supply base performance on Quality, Delivery and Cost (QCD)
  *  Realization of a measurable value >3% in recurring and P&L effective cost reductions per year across the global 3rd party spend in the assigned spend categories accompanied by a leveraged and benchmarked supply base management
  *  Grow and further develop a qualified and performing Best Cost Country Supply Base in line with the companies and operations BCC objectives preferably in Eastern Europe and manage a sustainable spend allocation


Responsibilities:

  *  Management of own material categories (capacity, knowledge management, performance)
  *  Accountable for contributing to the global Direct Material & Supply Base Performance (QCD)
  *  Representing own direct material categories within the VAT organization
  *  Accountable for the category specific achievement of the objectives of cost optimization, supply base optimization, geographic sourcing footprint and Best Cost Country Sourcing
  *  Providing forward-looking guidance on trends, threats and opportunities in own categories (eg. raw materials etc.)
  *  Active contribution to the bottom up alignment of the Direct Materials Category Team with the defined / set company objectives
  *  Interface to BU / Engineering for Strategic Sourcing activities along with the PDP (IP07) process
  *  Act as a change agent in regards to main stakeholders
  *  Perform the development of category sourcing strategies applying and complying with defined methods and tools
  *  Active supplier relationship management of the global supply base within its own category perimeter in alignment with the category teams in Switzerland, Malaysia and Romania
  *  Ensure consistent application of all Sourcing Levers
  *  Contribution to main Sourcing KPIs
  *  Assembles and actively leads category specific / cross-functional sourcing board
  *  Actively monitors and performs a supply base risk assessment across its own categories
  *  Participates in and contributes to continuous improvement of direct material practices


Qualifications:  

  *  3-4 years in-depth strategic and operational sourcing experience with a solid working knowledge of global category management
  *  Demonstrated work experience on category specific production techniques and processes
  *  Knowledge about category sourcing markets
  *  Office Software / IT application (esp. Excel, Word, Power Point, etc.)
  *  Sourcing in Eastern Europe, Asia and experience in Best Cost Country and spend relocation activities
  *  Working experience within a global complex organization
  *  Experience in the field of machine building, vacuum technology and semiconductors
  *  Cross-function / category team management (min. functional)
  *  Sensible and emphatic communication skills with suppliers, colleagues, internal stakeholders, etc.
  *  Strong analytical skills (risk based) and focus on the essential facts
  *  Able to get results through others, able to multi-task, sense of priority, able to handle stress levels
  *  Good communication skills in German and English (any other language will be a plus)

title: Local Hosting Service Owner (m/f/d) (80-100%)
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

As a Local Hosting Service Owner (m/f/d), you are responsible for the reliable, secure, and cost-efficient delivery of local hosting and infrastructure services across Accelleron’s locations in Switzerland.


You take end-to-end ownership of on-premises hosting environments, including servers, virtualization, storage, dedicated High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments, and local data center infrastructure, ensuring stable operations, continuous improvement, service quality, and alignment with business needs.

Acting as the key interface between factory IT, global Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams, service providers, and external partners, you ensure local requirements, enterprise standards, security policies, and strategic technology initiatives are effectively aligned and implemented. Customer Service Manager (m/w/d)

**What if your next job lets you simplify payments for millions, every single day?**

Join Nexi and be part of a collaborative, inclusive workplace where you can learn, grow, and make an impact everyday.

At Nexi, we're simplifying the future of digital payments. As one of Europe's leading payment companies, we combine international scale with the dynamism of a fast\-moving tech company. As Customer Service Manager (Acquiring) for Switzerland, you lead and develop the Acquiring Customer Service team (1st \& 2nd Level), ensuring consistently high service quality in a demanding, regulated, and customer‑critical environment. You are accountable for team performance, operational stability, and customer satisfaction—particularly in situations involving escalations, incidents, complaints, or highly frustrated customers. You act as both a people leader and an operational anchor: coaching your team to remain calm, empathetic, and solution‑oriented, while ensuring processes, controls, and service levels are met across all acquiring platforms. You are also a clear contributor in incident and crisis management.  

**Key Responsibilities**

People Leadership \& Team Development

* Support onboarding, training, and continuous skill development (technical, regulatory, and communication skills).

Operational \& Service Management

* Ensure stable day‑to‑day operations of the acquiring customer support function, including workload planning, prioritization, and resource allocation.

* Support Operations team in crisis management during major incidents


Process, Quality \& Compliance

* Ensure adherence to defined processes, regulatory requirements, and internal controls within the acquiring environment.
* Drive continuous improvement of support processes, documentation quality, and knowledge management.
* Review and analyze recurring issues, complaints, or root causes, and initiate sustainable improvements.
* Ensure accurate and complete documentation in CRM and ticketing systems.


Stakeholder \& Interface Management

* Act as the primary escalation and coordination point for Sales, Key Account Management, Operations, Risk, and external partners.
* Collaborate closely with specialist teams (e.g. Switzerland, Germany, Denmark, Croatia) to ensure smooth case resolution and clear ownership.
* Provide transparency to internal stakeholders through regular updates, reporting, and structured communication.


Reporting \& Continuous Improvement

* Track and analyze key KPIs (e.g. tNPS, NPS, case volumes, resolution times, complaint trends, customer feedback).
* Translate insights into concrete action plans for service, quality, and team performance improvements.
* Actively contribute to projects, system enhancements, or process changes impacting customer support.



**Qualifications**

Professional Background

* Completed commercial or business education, ideally supplemented by leadership training.
* Several years of experience in customer support or service operations, preferably in acquiring, payments, or a regulated financial environment.
* Proven experience in people leadership.
* **Fluency in German and / or French** (spoken and written), English mandatory, additional languages are an asset.




Leadership \& Personal Skills

* Strong people‑centric leadership style, combining empathy with clarity and accountability.
* Highly solution‑oriented and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership

title: Field Operator
description:
The Ansaldo Energia Group is one of the world's leading power generation companies. Its core
business is the supply and service of components and technological solutions for power generation
with rotating machines. The company designs and manufactures turbines and generators, and
provides service and continuous improvement. Headquartered in Genoa, the Group employs more
than 3,300 people and has a strong international presence with more than 30 offices around the world.
Ansaldo Energia is one of the leading players in the transformation and decarbonisation of power
generation. Its turbogas fleet is already capable of burning between 40 and 70 per cent hydrogen, with
the aim of reaching 100 per cent by 2030.

Join our Gas Turbine Test Facility team in Birr (AG) as a  

**Field Operator**

As a Field Operator, you are responsible for ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of the
equipment and systems within Ansaldo Energia’s Test Power Plant. You carry out routine plant
inspections, perform switching and isolation activities, support commissioning, testing and
maintenance work, and help ensure that all plant assets remain in a safe and operational condition.
Working closely with Control Room Operators, Maintenance, Engineering, and Commissioning teams,
you play a key role in maintaining plant availability, operational readiness, and overall operational
excellence.

**Your tasks **
• Conduct routine inspections of plant equipment and systems in the field
• Monitor equipment condition and identify abnormalities, leaks, unusual noises, vibrations, or safety
concerns  
• Execute plant start-up, shutdown and operational procedures as instructed by the Control Room
Operator  
• Perform switching, isolation and lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) activities in accordance with plant
procedures  
• Issue and control Permit-to-Work documentation
• Operate and monitor mechanical, electrical and auxiliary plant systems
• Support troubleshooting activities during operational disturbances and emergency situations
• Assist maintenance teams during outages, overhauls and repair activities
• Support commissioning and recommissioning of plant equipment and systems
• Record operational data, inspection findings and equipment status reports
• Ensure housekeeping standards and compliance with all safety, health and environmental
requirements
• Participate in emergency response drills and activities

**Your profile **
• Technical apprenticeship in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation or Process Engineering or
equivalent
• Several years of experience in power plants, industrial facilities, oil & gas, chemical, or process
industries; experience in plant commissioning activities is considered an advantage.
• Strong understanding of rotating equipment, pumps, compressors, valves and auxiliary systems
• Experience with switching operations and plant isolation procedures is an advantage
• Knowledge of Permit-to-Work and LOTO systems
• Strong awareness of health, safety and environmental requirements
• Hands-on mentality with strong teamwork and communication skills
• Willingness to occasionally work in a rotating shift system based on operational requirements
• Good command of English; German language skills at conversational level are highly desirable
• Willingness to travel internationally for up to 30% of working time, providing opportunities to
participate in commissioning projects, support customer operations, and gain exposure to power
plants around the world.

**Your benefit with us**
• A challenging and diverse role in a modern power generation environment
• Exposure to advanced gas turbines and power generation technologies
• A collaborative international team
• Professional training and development opportunities
• Competitive employment conditions
• Modern workplace in Birr (AG), Switzerland

**If you are looking for a challenging role in an international and future-oriented company, we
look forward to receiving your application through our career portal:
ansaldoenergia.com/discover-our-job-opportunities.  
For any questions, please contact us at jobs@ansaldoenergia.com**

title: Relationship Officer - Nachlässe
description:
Join MSF OCG as Relationship Officer - Nachlässe!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
Als Relationship Officer Nachlässe sind Sie Teil des Teams General Public Fundraising, das zur Abteilung Kommunikation & Fundraising von Ärzte ohne Grenzen Schweiz gehört.
In dieser Funktion sind Sie Hauptansprechpartner:in von Ärzte ohne Grenzen Schweiz für Personen, die Interesse bekundet oder bereits bestätigt haben, die Organisation in ihrem Nachlass zu berücksichtigen (Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors). Sie bauen zu diesen Personen eine vertrauensvolle, persönliche und langfristige Beziehung auf und stehen ihnen während des gesamten Prozesses professionell zur Seite.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Nachlassteam sorgen Sie dafür, die Bedürfnisse und Erwartungen der Spender:innen zu ermitteln, die entsprechenden Massnahmen zu koordinieren und gleichbleibend hohe Qualität in der Betreuung zu gewährleisten.
Sie arbeiten zudem eng mit der:dem Legacy Marketing Officer zusammen, um ein reibungsloses Zusammenspiel von Marketingaktivitäten, Massnahmen zur Gewinnung neuer Spender:innen sowie Beziehungsmanagement und Stewardship sicherzustellen und zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung des Spendenprozesses beizutragen.
Schliesslich tragen Sie zur Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung der Tätigkeiten im Nachlassbereich bei. Dazu verwalten und bearbeiten Sie die Daten im CRM, analysieren relevante Kennzahlen, erstellen Berichte und stellen die finanzielle Überwachung der Aktivitäten sicher.
Verantwortungsbereich
Pflege der Beziehungen zu den Spender:innen und Stewardship
•    Hauptansprechpartner:in von Personen, die Interesse bekundet oder bereits bestätigt haben, die Organisation in ihrem Nachlass zu berücksichtigen (Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors)
•    Verwaltung und Ausbau eines Portfolios von Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors durch individuelle und kompetente Betreuung
•    Aufbau und Pflege einer langfristigen und vertrauensvollen Beziehung zu potenziellen und bestehenden Spender:innen
•    Ermittlung der Erwartungen, Beweggründe und Bedürfnisse der Spender:innen und entsprechende Anpassung der Massnahmen im Bereich Stewardship
•    Beantworten von allgemeinen Anfragen zum Thema Nachlass und Weiterleiten von rechtlichen, technischen oder vermögensrechtlichen Fragen an die Senior Legal Officers
•    Organisation von Terminen, Telefongesprächen oder Besuchen zur Pflege und zum Ausbau der Kontakte
•    Präsentation von Projekten, Aktivitäten und der Wirkung der Arbeit von Ärzte ohne Grenzen, um über den Auftrag der Organisation ausführlich zu informieren und das langfristige Engagement zu stärken.
•    Sicherstellen einer angenehmen, persönlichen und kompetenten Betreuung während des gesamten Prozesses
Kontaktpflege, Veranstaltungen und Spender:innenbindung
•    Konzeption und Umsetzung von Massnahmen zur Kontaktpflege und Betreuung von potenziellen Spender:innen, Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors
•    Konzeption, Planung und Organisation von Veranstaltungen im Nachlassbereich (Vorträge, Treffen, Besuche, Dankesveranstaltungen usw.)
•    Komplette Organisation der Veranstaltungen: Von der Planung und Suche nach geeigneten Orten über Einladungen, Bearbeitung der Anmeldungen und Koordination von Referent:innen und Dienstleister:innen bis hin zur Organisation von Verpflegung oder Kommunikationsmaterial sowie der Nachbearbeitung
•    Erarbeiten von neuen Massnahmen und Formaten zur Stärkung der Spender:innenbindung
•    Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Verbesserung der «Donor Journeys» – sämtlichen Kontaktpunkten der Spender.innen mit der Organisation
Zusammenarbeit mit der:dem Legacy Marketing Officer  
•    Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der:dem Legacy Marketing Officer, um ein reibungsloses Zusammenspiel von Marketingaktivitäten, Massnahmen zur Gewinnung neuer Spender:innen, dem Beziehungsaufbau und der Pflege bestehender Spender:innen sicherzustellen
•    Betreuung der neuen Spender:innen aus Kampagnen und Marketingmassnahmen im Nachlassbereich
•    Rückmeldungen, Erkenntnisse und aus dem Austausch mit potenziellen und bestehenden Spender:innen ermittelte Bedürfnisse weitermelden, um zur Verbesserung von Kampagnen, Kommunikationsinhalten und -tools beizutragen
•    Mitarbeit an der Entwicklung von Inhalten, Tools und Kommunikationsmassnahmen für potenzielle Spender:innen, Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors
•    Beitrag zur Evaluierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Marketingmassnahmen und bei der Betreuung der Spender:innen
CRM, Portfolio-Betreuung und interne Koordination
•    Betreuung des Portfolios aus potenziellen Spender:innen, Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors im CRM
•    Sicherstellen der Qualität, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität der personenbezogenen Daten, der Interaktionen und Folgemassnahmen
•    Systematische Verfolgung der Entwicklung des Portfolios; Weitergabe relevanter Informationen an das Nachlassteam
